tei:div.tei:p: ltar shes pas zhen pa kun spangs kyang*/ /brtse ba chen pos srid pa mi gtong zhing

| | thabs la mkhas pas tshogs gnyis sdud byed pa/ /'di ni ma 'ongs pa yi sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga po 'di chos kyi skyes su 'bul ba lags/ shes nas dad pa'i yid dang ldan gyur pa/ khyod kyi thugs dgongs dge ba rdzogs bgyi'i slad/ /de skad brjod la nongs gang bzod par gsol/ /dge bas 'gro kun byang chub thob par shog /me mo yos bu'i lo dbyar zla tha chungs la bris pa'o// // ༄༅/ /sdom brtson zhig la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo | | tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs 'khrungs shing*/ /ye shes bzhi yi rang bzhin las grub la/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i bang rim nyer mdzes pa/ /rgyal ba lhun po'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa min yang 'phags pa'i ming can gyi/ /mngon sum min yang mngon sum ji bzhin du/ /dad dang dga' ba'i 'dzum zer legs bstan nas/ /sdom brtson khyed kyi snyan du 'di gsol lo/ / bdag cag bde bar sa skya'i chos ∶ grwar (《 zha 》 grwa chen por ) sleb bdog khyod kyang sku khams bde zhing*/ brtul zhugs dri ma med la gnas nas/ gcig tu dkar zhing rnam par dge ba'i mdzad spyod 'ba' zhig gis bdag dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrubs nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtshor nye bar gzhol zhing bzhugs pa khums shing*/ khyed thugs dge ba las byung ba'i/ /spring yig mthong bas bdag gi yid/ /dga' ba ngang gis 'phel ba ni/ /dbyar gyi chu klung ji bzhin no/ /gzhan yang skabs kyi don la/ sku khams legs par btsa' bar zhu | thugs dam la brtson par bskul ci 'tshal/ khyed kyi gsung ltar nged kyis kyang | lha sde mi sde spyi la gang phan pa'i bkod pa byed pa lags/ yi ge'i rten la gsol ja bzang po khod cig dang*/ thugs dam gyi zhal khab rgyu dar par ma yug gcig mdog bsil zer chu shel la phog ltar/

/spring yig gzigs pas khyed kyi thugs/ /dgyes pa'i chu gter rab 'phel nas/ /'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho'i gnas gyur cig /me mo glang gi lo/ khra'i zla ba'i tshes bzhi la sa skyar bris pa'i yi ge bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /blo gros seng ge la bskul ba'i nyams len mdor bsdus bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma ∶ dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs (《 zha 》 dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas ) la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu 'chi ba bsam par bya/ /de yis tshe 'di'i zhen pa ldog /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran par bya/ /srid la smon pa'i yid bral 'gyur/ /'gro la byams brtse bsgoms pa yis/ /cig tu bdag don gnyer ba ldog /chos rnams stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa spong bar 'gyur/ /rang lus lhag pa'i lha ru bsgom/ /de yis tha mal mngon zhen ldog | rtag tu sngags kyi bzlas pa bya/ /de yis ngag gi sgrib pa spong*/ /stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug bsgom/ /yid kyi dri ma dag par 'gyur/ /spy-i bor bla ma mos gus bya/ /byin brlabs ye shes nye bar 'gyur/ /bde ba dkon mchog drin du bsam/ /'byor pa'ang lam du 'gyur ba yin/ /gdung bas las ngan dag par bsam/ /sdug bsngal myong ba'ang lam du 'gyur/ /dge ba gzhan gyi don du bsngo/ /mi zad pa yi gtair du 'gyur/ /za mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ / mdor bsdus go bder bkod pa yin/ /dpon blo gros seng ges bskul nas/ 'phags pas me mo yos bu'i lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis la dpal sa skyar yi ger bkod pa'o// // ༄༅/ /rgyal bu ji big de mur la spring ba (《 zha 》+ dang po ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo | | kun nas brtse ba'i thugs mnga' ba/ /kun kyang sdug bsngal las sgrol zhing | | kun tu mi bzad stobs mnga' ba/ /kun mkhyen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rgyal po'i rigs su nyer bskrun zhing*/ /rgyal ba'i sras su dam bcas par/

/ rgyal bu ji big de mur ni/ /rgyal ba ji bzhin rgyal gyur cig /'phags pa mchog gis legs gsungs pa'i/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi chos tshul gyis/ / 'phags mchog nyid ni thob 'dod pa'i/ /'phags pas spring yig 'di 'bul lo | khyod kyi ngang tshul bzang po'i thugs/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang bgyis te | | de bzhin sngon chad ma 'tshal yang*/ /yang dag nges par da gyur to/ /de skad (《 zha 》 slad ) bdag yid dge ba ni/ /pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar/ khyod kyi dad pa'i yid bzhin mtshor/ /kun nas gzhol zhing 'bab pa lags/ /de 'dra'i tshul la tshul bzhin du/ /nyid kyi dgongs pas nyer dgongs nas/ /phan tshun 'brel pas 'brel pa'i yid/ /mi 'bral bshes kyi'ang bshes su mchi/ /bdag gis dge ba ci bgyis dang*/ /nyid kyis dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de kun gcig tu 'dres gyur nas/ /bdag cag gnyis ka'i don 'grub shog /de ltar snyan du gsol ba yi/ /spring yig bris pas slar yang ni/ /mjal ba'i 'dun pa ches cher gyur/ /'dun pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig khyod ni sku tshe ring ba dang*/ / snyun med dpal 'byor phun tshogs pas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang | | 'gro ba ma lus skyong gyur cig /srid pa kun tu bdag cag gnyis/ / 'bral med lhan cig gnas gyur nas/ /phan tshun bsod nams ye shes tshogs// rdzogs pa'i rkyen du 'gyur bar shog /'brug lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la/ ∶ chen je'ur (《 zha 》 tshen rdze'ur ) bris pa'i yi ge bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /yang de la spring ba (《 zha 》+ gnyis pa ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*/ /sgrib pa'i sprin las rnam par grol/ /legs par bshad pa'i 'od 'phro ba/ /sangs rgyas nyi mas khyod skyongs shig /spros med zhi ba'i ngang bsil zhing*/ /rnam rtog rab rib rnam par 'phrog | chags pa'i gdungs sel 'od 'byin pa/ /dam chos zla bas khyod skyongs shig /tshul khrims dag pa'i dbyibs mdzes shing*/

/ting 'dzin zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /'dod rgu'i dpal 'bras kun sbyin pa/ /dge 'dun rin chen gyis skyongs shig /rigs gzugs 'byor pa'i dpal ldan zhing*/ /dad dang shes rab phun sum tshogs/ khyad par bdag la rab 'dun pa/ /rgyal bu ji big de mur khyod/ /tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /ston pa'i bstan pa rgyas byed cing | | gzhan yang khyod kyis gang dgongs pa/ /de kun chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig | chu pho spre'u'i lo gsar pa la bskur ba'o// // ༄༅/ /yi gyang ∶ jus (《 zha 》 ju yar la ) glegs bam bsgrubs pa la bsngags pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru rat+na tra yā ya/ dpal kun gyi ni 'byung gnas te/ / nyes pa thams cad drung nas 'byin/ /che ba'i che bas cher mchod pa/ /sangs rgyas dpal gyi phul la 'dud/ khyod kyi legs bshad seng ge'i sgra/ /sems can grangs bzhin pha mtha' yas/ /'on kyang gdul bya'i dbang byas nas/ /sdud pos nges pa bzhin du bsdus/ /tshul de 'phags pa'i yul nas ni/ /yul gzhan dag tu'ang gsal bar gyur/ khyad par thub pa nongs nas lo/ /stong nas brtsams te rgya yul du/ /mdo dang dgongs 'grel de 'grel bcas/ /rim pa bzhin du bsgyur ba rnams/ /skye mchog rnams kyis yi ge'i rgyar/ /bsgrubs nas btab pa'i glegs bam tshogs/ /rgya nag chen por bzhugs mod kyang*/ /si tshon la sogs yul gzhan du/ /sngon chad rdzogs par mi bzhugs pa/ /de bzhugs pa dang rgyas bya'i phyir/ /hor gyi dbang byas te'u ca'o la/ /dbang bsgyur dbang po lnga pa ni/ /yon tan sna tshogs lon pa ste/ /de ming rgyal po gan zhes bya/ /de yi ring la ji wan nas/ /brtsams te lo bdun lon pa'i lor/ /chos rje sa skya pa yi 'bangs | | 'phags pa ti shri'i slob ma ni/ /si tshon yul du skyes gyur zhing*/ / chos la blo gros legs sbyangs pa/ /rgya dang bod dang bal po dang*/ /rgya gar sogs kyi rten mchog dang*/ /mkhas pa'i mchog rnams legs mthong zhing*/

/de dag rnams kyi drin thob nas/ /drin la lan du ldon 'dod pa/ /yi gyang ju zhes bya ba yis/ /par la glegs bam yongs rdzogs par/ /bsgrubs nas don chen legs par bsgrubs/ /'di yi dge bas chos tshul 'di/ /cig car kun tu rgyas gyur cig /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'ang 'grub par shog /rgyal po yun ring gnas gyur cig /rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong bar shog /rgyal khams dag kyang bde gyur cig /yi ge 'di ni yi gyang jus/ /yang dang yang du rab bskul nas/ /dge slong 'phags pas dge ba'i blos/ /sdeb sbyor rnam par sbyar 'di bsdebs/ / phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' la gnang ba'i bka' yig bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo | | zag pa med dbyings nam mkha'i khams/ /thugs rje'i sprin gyis khyab mdzad de/ /dri med chos kyi char 'bebs pa/ /sangs rgyas klu dbang la phyag 'tshal | | rgyal bu khyod kyis sangs rgyas la/ /srid pa snga mar tshogs rab bsags | | de yi dbang gis sku tshe 'dir/ /phun tshogs brnyes khyod rgyal gyur cig | sngon yang sangs rgyas bstan la khyod/ /dad pa'i bag chags cher sad pas | | 'dir yang mi phyed dad pa'i thugs/ /dag pa khyod ni rgyal gyur cig khyod kyis bde 'gro'i dpal 'byor mchog /brnyes pa snga ma'i 'bras bu lags// slar yang dam pa'i chos kyis thugs/ /grol gyur khyod ni rgyal gyur cig khyod kyis rgyal srid rgyal po yi/ khrims bzhin bskyangs pa ngo mtshar mod/ /de dag bas kyang dam chos kyis/ /bdag gzhan phan bgyid ngo mtshar lags/ /slar yang khyod kyi ngo mtshar gyi/ /mdzad spyod phyogs su rgyas pa dang*/ /sku tshe'ang kun nas brtan bya'i phyir/ /shis pa de dag brjod pa lags/ /de ltar bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa sngon du brjod nas/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa'i snyan du chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spy-i bos len pa chos smra ba 'phags pas zhu ba'i tshig yi ger bkod nas phyag tu phul ba/

rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' sku khams bzang zhing phrin las rgya che bar bzhugs pa thos pas yid dga' | nged yon mchod thams cad kyang bde bar mchis/ khyed kyis thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs nas spyir rgyal khams dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan par dgongs pa'i mdzad pa rgya chen po dang*/ bye brag tu bdag cag lta bu'i dman pa'ang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi khongs su chud par mdzad nas/ gsung snyan po bdud rtsi'i rgyun lta bu/ dngos po rnam par dag pa'i zang zing dang bcas pa gnang ba thugs dgongs dag pa'i stobs kyis bdag gi lag tu phyin pas yid dga' ba ngang gis 'phel bar gyur/ sngar yang ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du nged kyi phyogs nas rang don gtso bor ma byas par/ bklags dang nus pa yod tshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ sems can spyi la gang phan bgyis pa lags/ 'on kyang snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gyur ba dang*/ sems can spyi mthun gyi las gang zag re res bzlog dka' bar gda'/ da dung yang zhal ta bzhin du nus tshad kyis bsgrub pa lags/ khyod kyis kyang thugs la cher gdags par zhu/ mjal bar 'dod pa'i mdun pa shin tu che bar mchis pas/ ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du myur du mjal ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa lags | slar yang zhu ba'i tshig tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ khyod kyi dpal 'byor phun tshogs pa/ /lhun grub phyir na 'bad ci 'tshal/ /'dir ni sku tshe brtan phyir dang*/ /mthar thug byang chub chen po'i phyir/ /dgongs pa dag pa khyod kyi thugs/ /g.yel ba med par dgongs 'tshal lo/ /bzhes pa'i tshod kyang rig pa dang*/ /gshegs dang bzhugs gnas brtag pa dang*/ /nyon mongs dbang du mi 'gyur ba/ /'di gsum bde bar gnas pa'i rgyu/ /gzhan gyi srog la byams pa dang*/ /lus sems dben par gnas pa dang*/ /dge dang rnal 'byor rab brtson pa/ /'di gsum sku tshe brtan pa'i rgyu/ /sdig pa'i las las ldog pa

dang | | dge la spro bas bsgrub pa dang*/ /stong nyid snying rjes sems 'dul ba/ / 'di gsum byang chub chen po'i rgyu/ /sum tshan gsum du spel ba yi/ /chos tshul rnam pa dgu po 'di/ /rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' la/ /'phags pa'i 'dab nor chen po lags/ /rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dang | gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa gcig thugs dam du 'bul// // ༄༅/ /rgyal bu algo la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /ye shes lhun po'i phrin las bang rim can/ /gzhan don bsdu ba'i ljon pas rab brgyan pa/ /rgyal ba ri yi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal rgyud chen po'i rigs su nye bar 'khrungs shing bsod nams chen po'i dpal 'byor rab tu brnyes nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang skye rgu rnams kyi rtsa lag dam par gyur pa/ rgyal bu algo'i snyan du/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi 'od zer gyis/ blo'i pad+mo kha phyai zhing*/ sde snod dang rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i dge slong 'phags pas zhu ba/ rgyal bu sku khams bzang zhing phrin las rgya che la/ rgyal po 'di dang yang thugs gcugs par bzhugs pa thos pas yid spro ba khyad par can skyes/ mjal zhing gsung gleng byed par 'dod pa la gnas kyi bskal/ 'on kyang bsam pa rnam par dag pas smon lam khyad par can 'debs shing mchis/ slad ma zhu ba'i don 'ga' zhig tshigs su bcad de zhu ba/ khyod kyis bde 'gro'i dpal 'byor mchog brnyes pa/ /snga mar dge ba spyad pa'i 'bras bu lags/ /de slad slar yang bsod nams brtan bya'i phyir/ /gcig tu dge la brtson par mdzad par rigs/ /ljon shing bzang po ji srid gnas gyur pa/ /de srid me tog 'bras bu de las 'byung | | de bzhin gzhan phan 'bras bu gang lags pa/ khyod 'dra ba las 'byung ba de slad du/

/bsrung ba dam pa'i khor yug gis bskor zhing*/ /dge bar spyad pa'i chab kyis rab brlan te/ /nyid kyi ting 'dzin dgongs pa'i nyi drod kyis/ / sku tshe'i rtsa ba kun nas bskyang du gsol/ /mkha' la 'dus pa'i sprin gyi char rgyun dang | | sa yi mthu yis lo tog 'bras 'byung ltar/ /mi dbang 'di dang khyod thugs gcugs pa las/ /'gro ba'i dpal 'byung phyir na de ltar dgongs/ / bzo bo dman pas bsgrubs kyang rin chen rgyan/ /chen po rnams kyis rgyan du srel ba ltar/ /tshig 'di bdag gis bsdebs kyang dam chos la/ /brten nas bgyis slad dang du bzhes par mdzod/ /yi ge'i rten du bdag gis rab tu gnas pa legs par bgyis pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje gcig 'bul zhing mchis/ phag lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshe bcu gnyis la cong tor bris// // ༄༅/ /rin chen pak+ṣi la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo

| | ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*/ /legs par bshad pa'i 'od zer phreng ba yis/ /skye rgu'i blo gros pad+ma rgyas mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas skye rgu'i sgron ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal po'i ∶ bur do (《 zha 》 'ur rdo ) nas/ lung dang rigs pa'i de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par smra ba'i dge slong 'phags pas/ rigs dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs shing*/ dad pa dang brtse ba'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas bstan pa dang 'gro ba la gcig tu sman pa/ rin chen pak+ṣa'i phyag tu spring ba/ khyod sngon legs par spyad pa'i mthus/ /dpal dang 'byor pa phun tshogs shing*/ /thabs dang shes rab khyad 'phags pas/ /gzhan la phan pa mtha' yas pa/ /thos pas bdag yid dga' ba ni/ /yar gyi ngo yi zla bzhin 'phel | | lhag bsam dag pa'i zla rgyas las/ /spring yig 'od zer spro bar bya/ / snang ba sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /rang bzhin spros bral nam mkha' bzhin/ /'di ni bden pa gnyis su bshad/ /de 'dra lta ba'i dam pa lags/ /rang don yal bar dor nas su/ /gnas skabs dge 'am sdig kyang rung*/ /gzhan la phan pa lhur len pa | | 'di 'dra spyod pa'i dam pa lags/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems dang*/ / lha dang dngos po'i de nyid las/ /mtshan ma med par mnyam mjog pa/ /'di 'dra bsgom pa'i dam pa lags/ /stong pa nyid dang snying rje yis/ /srid dang bzhi ba'i mtha' bkag nas/ /thar pa chen po'i grong bgrod pa/ /'di 'dra lam gyi dam pa lags/ /spangs dang rtogs pa phun tshogs shing*/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don grub nas/ /'khor ba ji srid gnas gyur pa/ /'di 'dra 'bras bu'i dam pa lags | | theg pa chen po kun bsdus pa/ /shin tu gsal ba'i ngag gis ni/ / tshigs su bcad par bsdebs pa 'di/ /chos kyi skyes su bskur ba lags/ /'di 'dra khyod kyis mkhyen bzhin du/ /bdag gis spring bar mi 'os mod/ /phan tshun 'dun par bgyi slad du/ /chos kyi gleng ba mdo tsam lags/

/slad ma skabs su bab pa'i don la/ sngar yang khyed rgyal bu algo'i drung du bzhugs pas mi sde thams cad la phan pa rgya cher byung 'dug da dung yang ji ltar phan pa mdzod/ khyod kyi thugs dam gyi rgyur rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i thang sku legs pa gcig bskur yod/ blo gros zla rgyas las byung ba'i | | spring yig bsil ba'i 'od zer gyis/ khyed thugs dgyes pa'i kun+da'i phreng | | rnam pa kun tu rgyas par shog /phag lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la cong tor bris// // ༄༅/ /paṇ+ḍi ta lak+ṣ+mī ka ra la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo | | dge slong blo gros kyi ming dang ldan pas/ blo gros kyi lus yongs su dag pa | sgra dang tshad ma'i mig gnyis dang ldan zhing*/ snyan ngag gi dbyangs snyan pa/ sdeb sbyor gyi lce'i dbang pos rnam pa du mar yongs su 'gyur ba'i sgra dbyangs sna tshogs pa kun tu sgrogs pas mkhas pa'i skye bo yid 'phrog par byed pa'i ngang tshul can/ bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta lak+ṣ+mī ka ra'i snyan du gsol pa/ khyed kyi rigs dang kun tu spyod pa dang*/ yon tan gyi tshul shong ston lo tsā ba'i spring yig las gsal bar khums/ deng sang dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang na/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba'i rgyu dang rkyen zung du 'jug pa'i byed pas/ bstan pa'i bya ba rjes su bsgrub cing*/ don du gnyer ba'i skye bo rnams kyi blo'i chu skyes rnam par rgyas par byed pa'i tshul gsal bar thos pas/ slar yang yid dga' ba'i chu gter rnam par 'phel bar gyur | kho bo yang 'phrad par 'dod mod/ re zhig gnas kyis bskal/ de lta na'ang 'dun pa'i yid las byung ba'i tshig rnam par sbyar ba'i yi ge phan tshun mthong bas 'phrad cing gleng langs byung ba dang ci'i phyir mi mtshungs/ bod kyi yul bsil zhing khams dang rjes su mthun pa'i kha zas med pas bsod nams dang ldan par 'gyur ba dka' yang*/

gzhan gyi don la nye bar zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sdug bsngal ba mthong yang gzhan gyi don la 'jug pa dang*/ mkhas pa'i skye bos mkhas pa'i bya ba rjes su bsgrubs pa la sna tshogs pa'i sdug bsngal khyad du gsod pa/ tshul lugs lags par mkhyen grang*/ de de ltar dgongs nas/ da dung du yang bal po'i yul tshun chad du yun ring du bzhugs nas | mkhas pa'i bya bas gzhan la phan pa rjes su bsgrub par zhu/ de ltar zhu ba'i rten du sa le sbram srang gang pa gcig mchis/ rta lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga la rgya nag cong tor bris// // ༄༅/ /shong ston lo tsā la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma (《 zha 》+ la na mo/ ) 'phags pas/ shong ston lo tsā ba'i snyan du gsol ba/ mkhas pas shes par bya ba yi/ /shes byas shes rab lhun sdug par/ /gyur pas mkhas gzhan zil gnon zhing*/ /blo gsal rnams kyi yid g.yo bar/ /byed pas sngon gyi dam pa dang*/ /mtshungs pa nyid du gang gyur pa | | sdom brtson skad gnyis smra ba khyod/ /yun ring gnas shing rgyal gyur cig/'gro ba kun gyi yid la 'jam pa'i dpal/ /zhugs shing ngag la rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ /nye bar zhugs nas blo dang ngag gi dpal/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor pas 'byor gyur cig /ma lus phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing kun sman dang 'bras bcud phun tshogs shing*/ /skye rgu'i tshogs rnams 'tshe ba med la bde ba kun la longs spyod pa/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa'ang phyogs rnams kun tu rab rgyas te/ /'gro ba'i chos tshul dri med spyad nas kun kyang sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /shong ston la'o// // ༄༅/ /rwa dbon la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /gzhung lugs brgya phrag du ma'i chu klung dang*/ /rigs tshogs stong phrag mang po'i 'od 'gyed la/ /yon tan rin chen ∶ mang po'i (《 zha 》 'bum phrag ) mdzod 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas klu yi dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/

/legs bshad 'bum phrag mang po'i 'od zer gyis/ /blo ldan bye ba mang po'i yid gsal zhing | | dad ldan khri phrag mang po tshim byas te/ /skye rgu grangs med bde ba'i rgyur gyur cig /rwa dbon la bskur ba'o// // ༄༅/ /ral gri la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ mkha' dbyings dag par skye rgu'i sgron ma'i dpal | | phun sum tshogs pa 'bar ba lhang nge ltar/ /yon tan phrin las 'od stong 'gyed pa po/ /rgyal ba srid gsum sgron ma rgyal gyur cig /'phags pas ral gri la spring ba/ nged la sa skya dang 'di phyogs na gnas pa'i gnas skabs dag tu/ khyed kyis bskur ba'i yi ge rnams rim pa bzhin du thengs shing mthong*/ snga ma dag gi lan ci rigs su springs la/ bar skabs su 'di ma bzod na mkhas pa'i 'khrul rtags yin zhes pa la sogs pa'i lan bris mod kyi khyed kyi yid ma bzod kyis dogs nas ma springs/ da res dkon mchog 'byung gnas la spring ba'i yi ge ni/ rtog pa dang mdo sde dag las 'byung ba'i lung*/ brtse ba ltar bcos nas spring ba'i snga ma ni/ rang nyid kyi lung gi don ma nges pas gnas ma yin pa la dogs pa'i phyir gyi na 'ga' (《 zha 》 'ba' ) zhig tu rtogs la/ gnyis pa'ang mi'i skye rgu dang bcas pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin la sogs pa mi ma yin pa'i 'byung po ches che ba dag gis bdag tu ma bzung ba 'ga' yang med pa'i phyir yul phyogs gang dang gang la 'tshe ba byas na de dang de'i bdag pos 'tshe ba'i lan byed pa tshul lugs yin pas/ bzlog par rigs na thams cad la thams cad du bzlog par rigs kyi le'u tshan kho na la bkar te ci'i phyir rjod par byed/ gsum pa'ang sangs rgyas kyis rgya'i yul gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs zhes pa ni yang dag pa ma yin te/ dri ma med pa'i lung dag las/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong lon pa'i tshe/ rgya'i yul du chos 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes 'byung ba dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/

/gzhan yang khyod kyi mi chos khral gyis nyen pa la phan pa'i thabs kyi khur nged gsum char la mnyam por bskur ba 'dug pas khong gnyis kyis ji ltar khur ba'i khur gyi cha shas kho bos kyang khur ba yin/ 'dir smras pa/ 'gro kun zhabs 'bring byed par de thugs bskyed/ /gnas skabs sprin bzhin 'byung bar thub pas gsungs/ /de yis de myong de ni las kyi mthu/ /de la mi bzod byed na blun po yin/ /gang zhig cung zad shes pa'i mngon rlom gyis/ /rnam par bsgribs pas rang gi rang bzhin dang | | gzhan gyi tshul yang tshul bzhin ma mthong bas/ /rtag tu mun par gyur pa ma yin nam/ /rang gi yon tan kun nas spyoms phyir dang*/ khengs pas khengs pa gzhan dag zil mnan phyir/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya bas dus 'da' yang*// ngal ba don med gyur pa ma yin nam/ /dpal dang grags pa'i gzi yis rab 'bar zhing*/ /gtsug lag du ma mthong zhing thos gyur kyang*/ /slar yang dul ba'i dpal gyis rab mdzes pa/ /srid pa gsum na dkon pa ma yin nam/ /gzhan yang khyod kyis bskur ba'i yi ge'i rten dag lung dang rgya gar gyi dpe dang*/ chos rje pas bsgyur ba'i bod kyi yi ge dang*/ mdo dang mdo las bstus pa las yang yang mthong zhing nges zin pa'i phyir/ gnas ma yin pa la ngo mtshar bar ston pa ni | ngo mtshar ba la mi mtshar dang*/ /mi mtshar ba la ngo mtshar du/ /rtogs pa de dag ngo mtshar las/ /shin tu ngo mtshar gyur pa yin/ /yang khyod kyi yi ge'i mjug na/ rgya gar kha che bal po'i bstan pa nub/ /bod kyi dge sbyong khe rnyed 'du 'dzis brel/ /shākya'i bstan pa yun ring mi gnas pas/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis bag yod brtson par gyis/ /zhes bris pa'ang*/ yang dag kho nar ma rtogs te | bstan pa nub sar gang la brtson par byed/ /rnyed pas g.yeng la thar pa 'dod pa ci/ /de phyir khyod kyis de skad 'doms pa yi/ /yul de gang na gnas pa su zhig yin/

khyed rang yang khe dang rnyed pa'i 'du 'dzis brel bar khas blangs 'dug pas yi ge'i rten du gser zho do bskur yod/ gzhan dag gi springs yi ge'i tshul las tshul gzhan du/ khyod kyi 'di ni kho bos mthong nas kho bo yi/ / spring yig gzhan las gzhan pa'i tshul gyis nyer sbyar nas/ khyod la springs 'di'ang 'di lta kho nar gzung bar gyis/ /bya lo dpyid zla 'bring po'i nyi shu gsum la shing kun du bris pa'i yi ge bkra shis par smon// // ༄༅/ / (《 zha 》+ 'phrin yig rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba ) spyi bo lhas pa bshes gnyen rin chen la bskur ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gdod nas nyer zhi zhi ba'i lam gyis zhi ba don gnyer skye bo rnams/ /srid zhi'i chos gnyis nye bar zhi ba'i zhi bde mchog la 'god mdzad pa/ /nyon mongs zhi zhing dbang po nyer zhi zhi ba'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor ba/ /zhi ba'i dpal gyis zhi nyid rab 'byor zhi ba bla med de la 'dud/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal gyi phul | | rab mchog dam pa'i gsung la yid/ /kun nas dang ba'i dpal brnyes pa'i | | mi yi dbang po phyogs bcur rgyal/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can rgya mtsho'i mtha' gtugs sa chen 'di na blo chen du/ /rlom chen ∶ 'ga' yang (《 zha 》 'gas kyang ) rlom pa mi mnga' blo chen chen po'i mkhyen rab kyi/ /cha yi char yang nye bar bsgrun min ches cher gsal ba'i grags ldan pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po bzang po'i zhabs kyi zhabs rdul gus len chos smra ba/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho ting 'dzin zhi ba'i pad+ma'i tshal/ /snyan pa grags pa'i dri bsung gis bsdus slob ma yi/ /bung ba'i sprin phung gdams pa'i sbrang rtsis tshim mdzad pa/ /bshes gnyen rin chen pad+mo'i tshal la don 'di zhu/ /de gcig kho nar ma zad de/ /de yi dbang gis nyer bsdus pa'i/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho la'ang*/ /phrin gyi tshul gyis bsnyad par bgyi/

khyed kyi thugs dgongs dag pa las byung ba'i spring yig bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rin po che'i rgyus nye bar bsgrub pa'i rgyan dang bcas pa | yul dang ljongs dang*/ grong khyer mang po'i lam nas brgyud nas nye zho med par kho bo'i sug tu phyin pas yid dga' ba yar gyi ngo bo'i zla ba bzhin du 'phel bar gyur/ slad ma skabs kyi don la/ khyed kyis ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du/ sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa dri ma med cing dgongs pa gcig pa yin la/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnam pa'ang lhag pa'i bsam pa 'dra ba yin mod/ de lta na yang*/ yul gyis cher bskal zhing*/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye bo mang pos log par bsgrubs pas ji skad bsams pa bzhin grub par dka' ba khyed kyi thugs la gsal/ nged sa'i phyogs 'di kun tu bsdad pa'i phyogs nas kyang bstan pa dang sems can spyi la phan pa 'bad nas bsgrubs pa yin yang*/ mos pa tha dad pa'i sems can rnams kyis sna tshogs su gleng ba chos nyid yin/ 'on kyang bden pa'i ngag la gzu bo'i tshig gsan te mchi/ slad nas khyed ji skad gsung ba bzhin du spyir bstan pa dang*/ bre brag khyed kyi phyogs su'ang gang phan pa dang*/ don du 'gyur ba byaid pa yin/ da res kyi skabs su mi'i dbang po dang lhan cig tu yod na/ dngos su brtson pa byed pa spro na'ang*/ cung zad gnas kyis bskal | 'on kyang zhu ba'i tshig nan tan can bskur ba lags/ phyin chad nged kyis kyang phan tshun ji ltar glengs pa bzhin du nus tshad kyis bsgrub pa yin/ khyed dpon slob rnams kyis kyang khyed rang ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du bsgrub pa khyed rang la rag las pa yin/ sangs rgyas nyi ma gdul bya yi/ /ri la nye bar nub par gyur/ /de yi bstan pa nyi 'od kyang*/ /nub la nye bar phyogs par gyur | | de ltar dgongs nas bstan pa dang*/ /'gro la bces par dgongs rnams kyis/ /dri med lung dang mi 'gal bar/

/shin tu brtson par bya bar rigs | | gsung rab rin chen gling las legs 'ongs shing*/ /rnam dpyod blo yis byi dor legs byas pa/ /spring yig legs par brjod pa'i rin chen phreng*// bsam pa dge bas legs par springs pa yin/ /de las dge ba dri med gang thob pas | | 'gro kun dri med chos kyi lam zhugs te/ /dri med byang chub spyod pa nyer spyad nas/ /dri med chos kyi dbang phyug nyid gyur cig khyi lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gcig la 'phags pas mi'i dbang po'i pho brang kha'i phing hur bris pa'o// // yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// ༄༅/ /chag lo tsā ba la bskur ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /ma chaXgs loX bdag tsha zer byed sogs kyis/ /mchod pa'i gnas gyur choXs nyid rdo rjeX yis/ /lta ngan ri 'joms gdul bya'i dpaXl gyur pa/ / bsgrub pa bzang po khyod ni rgyal gyur cig /chags lo tsā ba la bskur ba'o// // ༄༅/ /dbus gtsang gi mtshan nyid pa spyi la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rgya che zhing*/ /tshad med mkhyen pa'i 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /dri med chos kyi snang ba skyed mdzad pa/ /

mtshungs med chos rje skye rgu'i sgron mar 'dud/ /chos 'khor phyi ma'i dus su dbus kyi mtshan nyid pa spyi la bskur ba'o// // ༄༅/ /dbus kyi bka' gdams pa spyi la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /ji bzhin gzigs pas gzigs pa rnam dag cing*/ /ji snyed mkhyen pas mkhyen pa nyer zhi yang*/ /smon lam grub pas phrin las lhun grub pa | | thub pa phyag 'os de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbus kyi bka' gdams pa spyi la bskur ba'o// // ༄༅/ /stag lung pa la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /srid dang zhi ba'i bla ma mchog gi bla na med pa'i dpal 'bar zhing | | mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku dang yan lag drug cu'i gsung ldan la | | dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med thugs mnga' rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal nas/ /tshig dang ngag gi phreng ba bkod pas brda sprod byed pa 'di spring ngo | | stag lung pa la bskur ba'o// // ༄༅/ /dbus kyi sgom chen pa spyi la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /ting nge 'dzin dang sna tshogs thabs brtson pas/ /ting 'dzin brnyes pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba'i rnam 'phrul kun 'phrul ba/ /ting 'dzin mchog gi rol pa la phyag 'tshal/ /dbus kyi sgom chen pa rnams la bskur ba'o// // ༄༅/ /rgyal bu ji big la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*/ /sgrib pa'i sprin las rnam par grol/ /legs par bshad pa'i 'od 'phro ba/ /sangs rgyas nyi mas khyod skyongs shig /spros med zhi ba'i ngang bsil zhing*/ /rnam rtog rab rib rnam par 'phrogs | | chags pa'i gdung sel 'od 'byin pa/ /dam chos zla bas khyod skyongs shig /tshul khrims dag pa'i dbyibs mdzes shing*/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /'dod rgu'i dpal 'bras kun sbyin pa/ /dge 'dun rin chen khyod (《 zha 》 gyis ) skyongs shig /rigs gzugs 'byor pa'i dpal ldan zhing*// dad dang shes rab phun sum tshogs/ khyad par bdag la rab 'dun pa/

/rgyal bu ji big de mur khyod/ /tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /ston pa'i bstan pa rgyas byed cing*/ /gzhan yang khyod kyis gang dgongs pa/ /de kun chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /yang rgyal bu ji big la spring bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /spros pa med pa'i ngang nyid las/ /sprul pa'i spros pa spro mdzad cing | | spros dang spros pa med pa yi/ /sangs rgyas mnyam nyid chen por 'dud/ / rgyal ba mchog gi rjes zhugs shing*/ /rgyal ba'i sras su nyer bskrun la/ /rgyal bu ji big de mur ni/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis skyong gyur cig /spring yig 'di ni gzigs pas khyed kyi thugs/ /rnam par bde zhing ji ltar dgongs pa'i don/ / chos bzhin grub nas bstan dang 'gro ba yi/ /dpal du gyur nas yun ring zhabs brtan shog/ // ༄༅/ /yang rgyal bu ji big la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /mkhyen pa'i dpal ni rab gsal zhing*/ /thugs rje'i dpal ni nyer 'jug la/ /dus gsum dpal ni thogs med pa/ /sangs rgyas dpal gyis khyed skyongs shig /rgyal bu ji big la'o// // ༄༅/ /dpon mo du gal dur mis la spring ∶ ba (《 zha 》 yig gnyis kyi dang po ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dpal mgon rnams kyis gus btud cing*/ /dpal 'byor kun gyis rab 'byor ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /dad dang mkhyen rab rab gsal bas/ /don gnyis phun sum tshogs gyur pa/ /dpon mo du gal dur mis ni/ /phyogs dus kun nas rgyal gyur cig khyed thugs dges pa mtsho yi pad ltar rgyas/ /dge ba yar ngo'i zla bzhin ngang gis 'phel/ /sku tshe chu bo chen po'i rgyun ltar ring*/ /gsum po de yis rtag tu bde legs shog /dpon mo du gal dur mis la'o// // ༄༅/ /yang du gal dur mis la spring ∶ ba (《 zha 》 gnyis pa ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /chos kyi dbyings las byung gyur zhing*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid | | dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur pa/

/sgrol mas rtag tu khyod skyongs shig/ dpon mo du gal dur mis la'o// // ༄༅/ /rgyal bu jim gyim la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /'dir smras pa/ deng song 'di na lha rnams dga' ¡Ã ba ya ( ¡¶ zha ¡· byed pa'i ) / /blo ldan de dag gzugs dang de bzhin stobs/ /dbyangs dang 'byor pa ldan pas bdag dregs shing*/ /de mi ldan pa rnam par spong bar byed/ /dam pa dam pa'i skyes bu gang yin pa/ /dges shing dges par 'gyur ba'i ngang tshul yang | | gang la ldan pa gang yin de 'dra'i tshul/ /ji ltar yin pa ji bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /yid 'ong gzugs kyi dpal dang mi ldan yang*/ /chos rnams rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yi/ /blo gros chen po'i dpal gyis gtams pas na/ / blo mig ldan pa'i mdun na mdzes pa yin/ /lus stobs rgyas pa'i shugs dang mi ldan yang*/ /rnam dpyod stobs chen spobs pa'i yang rtsal gyi/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar rlom pas myos pa yi/ /rgol ba glang po'i dregs pa 'joms byed yin | | snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro mi ldan yang*/ /lung dang rigs pa'i de nyid ji bzhin du/ /rab tu ston pa'i tshig la dbang 'byor pas/ /mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog ngag dang ldan pa yin/ /zang zing 'byor pa phun tshogs med na yang*/ / srid zhi'i dge legs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /dam chos mi zad rin chen gter 'dzin pas/ /dam pa'i 'byor pas bdag nyid 'byor pa yin/ /'di la mi 'dun 'dun pa'i yid bral ba/ /de dag gis 'di 'di ltar ma yin zhes/ / bdag la rgol dang dang por brgal brtag gis/ khyod kyi shes rab rab tu gsal bar bya/ /smra bar byed pa dpal ldan 'phags pa ste/ /don dang ldan pa'ang de nyid yin par bsam/ /blo chen mkhyen pa rnams kyis mkhyen lags grang | | ma rtogs log par rtog pa blun po'i rtags/ /dpal gyi 'byung gnas bla ma dkon mchog gi /dpal gyi rgyal bu'i phrin las sku tshe dang*/ /dpal 'byor rgyas dang bstan dang 'gro ba yi/

/dpal du gyur nas yun ring gnas gyur cig/ rgyal bu khyod kyi thugs dgongs dge ba'i mthus/ /rgyal ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor bas/ /rgyal de'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rab rgyas shing*/ /rgyal sras khyod ni chos kyi rgyal por shog /rgyal bu jim gyim la bskur ba'o// // ༄༅/ /ho ko sogs la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /stobs sogs yon tan rin chen gter gyur cing*/ /chos sogs char 'bebs rnam sgrogs sprin chen te/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyis/ /rgyal bu khyod ni rtag tu skyong gyur cig /ho ko la'o// //mdangs dang dri ro phun sum tshogs gyur cing*/ /gnas skabs kun nas dga' ba'i dpal bskyed kyang*/ /mang du bsten na slar yang smad 'gyur ba/ / gang yin de yang rim gyis bsring bar rigs/ /gang gi gzi yi lha yi dpal 'byor yang*/ /zil gyis gnon na de las gzhan pa'i dpal/ /smos ci 'tshal ba gang de tshul khrims dang*/ /yon tan lags pa de slad de spel mdzod/ / grags bzang la'o// //blo che rlom che spaubs pa che/ /gzugs chung 'khos chung longs spyod chung*// chen po gsum dang chung ngu gsum/ /gcig la 'dzom pa de la spring*/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i rtsa ba rab brtan zhing*/ /mang du thos pa'i lo 'dab kyis phyug pa'i | | ting 'dzin zhi ba'i 'bras bus spud gyur pa'i/ /ston gzhon dpag bsam ljon pa rgyas gyur cig /ston gzhon la'o// // ༄༅/ /gos dar lnga stong dang dgu brgya bzhi bcu phul ba'i (《 zha 》+ dus kyi ) mchod brjod dang bsngo ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi mkha' la mngon 'phags shing*/ /ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor rnam par rgyas/ /legs bshad zer gyis gdul bya sad mdzad pa/ /bla ma skye rgu'i sgron la bdag skyabs mchi/ /bsod nams gser gyi dbang chen rab brtan zhing*/ /thugs rje'i chu gter zab cing rgya che ba/ /ye shes lhun po'i rgyal pos nyer mdzes pa/

/sangs rgyas rnam par rgyas pa'i rgya mtsho rgyal | | rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtsho las 'khrungs shing*/ /snang dang rtogs pa'i 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ / dam chos rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dpal la mngon brten zhing*/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen gter bzung nas/ /'gro ba'i dbul ba ma lus rnam sel ba/ /dge 'dun klu dbang 'dus pa'i zhabs la 'dud | | de ltar bsam pa dge bas kun bslangs nas/ /bsod nams zhing gi mchog rab dam pa la/ /nye bar bsgrubs pa'i mchod rdzas dri med 'di/ /kun bzang rnam 'phrul ji bzhin blos sprul nas/ /kun nas mchod pas mchod 'os thams cad ni/ /mchod pa kun gyis kun nas mnyes gyur nas/ /bdag dang bdag gi grogs gyur 'gro ba kun/ /kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan gyis legs gzigs te/ /thugs rje'i thugs kyis nye bar dgongs nas kyang*/ /mthu stobs dam pa'i stobs kyi dbang bgyis nas/ /srid dang rnam par grol ba'i dpal 'byor gyis/ /kun nas 'byor zhing dga' mgur spyod bgyi'i phyir/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams legs gsungs shing*/ /thun mong ba dang phul du byung ba yi | | dngos grub rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams gang lags pa/ /gegs med par yang nye bar stsal du gsol/ /de ltar mchod 'os rnams la legs mchod cing*/ / gsol bar 'os la tshul bzhin gsol ba las/ /kun tu dri med kun nas rgya che ba'i | | dge ba gang zhig bdag gis bskrun pa dang*/ /gzhan yang bdag gzhan kun gyis dus gsum du/ /rnam par dag pa'i dge ba gang bsgrubs pa/ /lhag bsam dag pas gcig tu bsdoms byas shing*/ /shes rab snying rje'i grogs kyis dbang byas pas/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /mtha' rnams ¡Ã kun la ( ¡¶ zha ¡· la yang ) rnam par mi gnas par/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis/ /kun mkhyen rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog

/de srid srid par las dang smon lam gyis/ /srid pa'i tshul yang srid par sbyor ba na/ /yon tan bdun dang ldan pa lha mi'i lus/ /dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thob gyur nas/ /yang dag bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung ste/ /thabs mchog zab mo'i lam la nyer zhugs nas/ /chos tshul ji bzhin rab tu spyad byas te/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes par byed par shog /rgyal dang rgyal sras bshes gnyen thams cad las/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams legs thos nas/ /chos kyi phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la/ /rgya chen chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par shog /rnam par grol ba'i lam du zhugs gyur nas/ /ting nge 'dzin dang de bzhin dpal 'byor pas/ /skye ba dam pa nye bar len pa na/ /skye bo kun skyob skye ba mchog thob shog /mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par/ /skad cig re la'ang spyod pa rgya mtsho yis/ /'phags pa mchod dang sems can smin byed cing*/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho yongs su sbyang bar shog /de ltar byang chub lam kun rdzogs byas te/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtsho cher zhugs nas/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /sems can thams cad yongs su sgrol bar shog | skye ba 'di nyid du yang tshe ring zhing*/ /nad med pa dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs/ /bar du gcod pa kun las rnam grol zhing*/ /bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin 'grub par shog /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid dang ni/ /yongs su bzung dang spyod pa'i sgo nas ni/ /mchod par 'os pa thams cad mnyes pa dang | | skye rgu kun la phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig /mi yi gtso rnams dul bar gnas pa dang*/ /skye rgu rnams kyang tshul lugs legs spyad cing*/ /phan tshun yid gcugs byas pa shes pa yi/ /'jig rten lugs kyi 'jig rten bde legs shog | sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis 'byor/ /dam pa'i chos ni nges par 'byin pa'i mchog /dge 'dun 'dus pa rnams kyi mchog gyur pa'i/

/ bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /chos skyong ba rnams gzi brjid dpal gyis lham/ /'jig rten skyong ba 'jig rten dpal gyis 'byor/ /bden par smra ba bden pa'i mthu ldan pa'i/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog | phyogs skyong ba yis phyogs mtshams bde legs byed/ /'byung ba'i lha yis 'byung ba dbang sgyur zhing*/ /dus kyi lha yis dus tshigs kun bsrung ba'i/ / bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing dang ni/ /bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba dang de bzhin du/ /bde legs byed pa'i rdzas rnams thams cad kyis/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog / chos dbyings spros pa zhi ba'i bden pa dang*/ /rten 'byung rgyu 'bras mi bslu'i bden pa dang*/ /dkon mchog gsum mchog gyur pa'i bden pa yis/ /bdag gi ji skad brjod bzhin 'grub par shog /gos dar lnga stong dang dgu brgya bzhi bcu tham pa phul ba'i dus kyi mchod brjod dang bsngo ba'o// // ༄༅/ /tshe dpag med la bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /sna tshogs 'dab rgyas chu skyes lte bar bsil zer can steng du/ / lhun po ltar brjid 'od zer cher 'phros pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /bdud rtsis yongs gang lhung bzed legs 'dzin mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med mgon gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// //'di la ma dmigs srid la mi smon zhing*/ /bdag la ma chags stong nyid snying rje yis/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis rnam bsal nas/ /sku gsum mngon du byed pa'i theg chen lam// //yan lag drug cu ldan pa'-i gsung dbyangs kyis/ /yon po'i gzhung lugs rnam par sun phyung nas/ /yin par nges pa'i chos don ston mdzad cing*// yun du 'gro la rnam par gsal gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /mgon g.yag la bsngags pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /gang lus char sprin phung po ni/ /mkha' la drag tu g.yo ltar snang | | de y-i sna dang kha sgo nas/

/rlangs pa sprin nag mched ltar 'phyur/ /lce ni glog ltar 'byung ( ¡¶ zha ¡· 'gyu ) ba ste/ /ngur sgra 'brug gi sgra ltar sgrogs/ /in+d+ra nī la'i brag lta bu'i/ /rmig pa brdabs pas sa gzhi g.yo/ /shin tu bskyod pa'i rwa rtse yis/ /ri bo'i lhun yang bsnyil bar nus/ /mig gnyis nyi ma zla ba ni/ /sprin mthong mkha' la g.yo ba bzhin/ /rnga ma ljon pa rgyas pa 'dra/ /de bskyod pa yis nam mkha'i sprin/ /rnam par 'thor ba bzhin du snang*/ /de yi sgra yis glu sgra yang | | kun nas rab tu zil gyis gnon/ /'di 'dra gangs can gnas pa yi// rkang bzhi pa yi ngo mtshar to/ /'di yid bsgṛn par gnas pa yi/ /rkang gnyis pa la'ang rab tu dkon/ /de 'dra brtse med skyes bu yi/ /mtshon las rab tu rgyal gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /chang la bsngags pa bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la phyag 'tshal lo | | sa yi snying po 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho dang*/ /de bzhin me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /rtsi sman sna tshogs sbyar ba'i phabs dang ni/ /'gro ba'i dag byed gyur pa'i chu gtsang rnams/ /snod dang rkyen dang sna tshogs sbyor ba dang*/ /

dus kyi 'gyur ba bzang pos yongs smin par/ /byas shing dwangs ma'i dwangs ma legs byung bas/ /'di yi rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pa yin/ /cher dwangs shel ltar snang ba'i lbu ba yi/ /phreng ba mu tig phreng bas spras 'dra ba/ /mthong bas mig gi dpal te chil chil sgra/ /thos pas rna ba'i dpal la bsung ngad kyis/ / dri 'dzin dbang po tshim par byed pa yin/ /kun nas myangs pas lce yi dpal yang bde/ /grang dang tsha ba'i tshe na drod dang ni/ /bsil byed lus kyi dbang po bde ba'i rgyu/ /mya ngan thibs pa sel ba'i nyi ma ste/ /dga' bde'i bsil ba bskyed pa'i zla ba yin/ /shes rab me lce 'bar byed rlung yin la/ /smra 'dod rnams kyi spobs pa'i dpal yang yin/ /g.yul ngor zhugs pa'i brtul zhugs skyed byed cing*/ /'dod ldan rnams kyi bde ba'ang rgyas byed yin/ /zhir 'dod rnams kyi rgyud la 'di yis ni/ /ting 'dzin dam pa lhug par bskyed pa yin/ /de phyir 'di ni btung ba'i phul yang yin/ /longs spyod rnams kyi snying por gyur pa yin | | de slad 'di ni mchod 'os mchod pa dang*/ /sbyin 'os rnams la sbyin par bya ba yin/ /chang la bsngags pa'i rab tu byed pa bdud rtsi'i bum pa zhes bya ba a+thi+-i || || ༄༅/ /mchod 'os la bsngags pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang las sangs rgyas chos tshogs kun 'byung na/ /dpal 'byor gzhan rnams smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas nyid shes nas/ / mtshungs med bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo chen phyir na lta ba dag / thugs rje che phyir spyod pa dag /dgongs pa zab phyir sgom pa yang*/ /dag par bdag gis khyod 'tshal lo/ /theg mchog tshul khrims bzang po yis/ khyod kyi sku lus rnam dag cing*/ /gsan pa'i tshogs dang ting 'dzin gyis/ /gsung dang thugs kyang dag pa lags/ /tshig don mkhas phyir bshad pa dag

/rigs dbang gyur phyir rtsod pa dag /sdeb sbyor pha rol son pa'i phyir/ /rtsom pa rnam par dag pa'ang khyod/ khyod kyis pha rol dgongs pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten gsog dang gsob tu gzigs/ /de phyir 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis/ /rtog pa rtog par khyod kyis dgongs/ /des na chos rnams btang snyoms su/ /'jog la ngo mtshar ci zhig mchis/ /'on kyang gzhan la ma mthong phyir/ khyod kyi ngo mtshar ma lags sam | | gser 'gyur rtsi yis lcags bzhin du/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin dang thugs | | ro gcig gyur pas bcos ma yi/ /tshul khrims khyod kyis bcos mar gzigs | | tshul 'di byis pa'i yum ( yul ) min phyir/ /byis pa rnams kyis rnam par smad/ /de 'dra dam pas bsngags pa'i phyir/ khyod nyid dam par bdag gis 'tshal | | ston pa khyod kyis 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa 'am | | 'on te sngon chad ma brnyes pa/ /bdag gis ji bzhin ma 'tshal mod/ khyod kyi legs bshad seng ge'i sgra/ /don mthun 'jigs med sgrogs pa dang*/ / gzhan gyis ma dpyad spyod pa gang*/ /'dzing pa du mas brgyan pa dang*/ /sdeb sbyor sbyar pa'i snyan ngag gis/ /ngag gzhan zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ /nyid kyi don la mi dgongs par/ /brtse bas gzhan don gzhol ba dang*/ /zab mo'i snying po thugs chud nas/ /ting 'dzin snying por mdzad pa sogs/ /dam pa gzhan la rab dkon pa/ khyod la lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul/ /'di la dpags na dam pa yi | | ye shes rgya mtshor zhugs pa'am/ /'on te ring por mi thogs par/ / 'jug par 'gyur ba nyid lags grang*/ /'di 'dra rtogs pas phyir zhing du/ /ngo mtshar slar zhing 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de 'dra gang na khyod bzhugs kyang*/ /nges par thugs su chud gyur cig /de ltar rab tu dang ba'i yid/ /'khrungs pa'i dge ba gang de yis/ /skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ khyod dang khyod 'dra ba yi bshes/ / sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang*/

/sngon du dran pas nyer sbrail te/ / gzhan gyi don la ro gcig tu/ /rnam pa kun tu rol par shog /'di ltar brjod par 'dod pa yis/ /'dun pa dag pas kun bslangs nas/ /mngon sum min yang mngon sum bzhin/ /rnam par bsams nas glengs pa lags/ /slar yang khyod la mchod pa'i phyir/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ni/ /kun bzang rnam 'phrul lta bu yis/ /mchod cing mchod par bgyid par shog /rin chen dri med gser srang gsum/ /mar mes mchod pa'i slad du 'bul/ /'bar bas mtshan pa'i gos dang ni/ /'gam ha rgyab yol nyid du 'bul/ /dar yug dmar po ma nyams pa/ khyod kyi cod pan slad du 'bul/ /slar yang gser srang lnga dang ni/ / dar gos gsum dang rta mchog gsum/ /rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang | | rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du 'bul/ /der bzhugs dge 'dun thams cad la | | tshab tsha'i bsnyen bkur zhig kyang 'bul/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba yang | | dam pa khyod la legs 'bul gyis/ khyod kyi dgongs pa gang lags pa | | de kun 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'gro ba bshes dang bral ba dang*/ / log pa'i bshes kyis zin gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad khyod 'dra yis/ /yang dag bshes kyis rjes 'dzin shog /'gro ba lam dang bral ba dang*/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad khyod bzhed pa'i/ /yang dag lam la 'jug par shog /de ltar mchod par 'os pa legs mchod nas/ /bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa'i cha tsam zhig /brjod pa 'di ni blo gros 'jigs med pa | | blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal gyis brjod pa yin/ /shing mo glang gi lo dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu bzhi la dpal sa skyar bris// // ༄༅/ /lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga dang bcas pa'i rtsis gzhi bzhugs// ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i gtso/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor ba/ /ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal te/ /rin chen 'od zer spro bar bya/

/bsil zer can la zhi ba sogs | | 'das pa bsres pa lo dag yin/ /nyi mas bsgyur la nag sogs sbyin | | gnas gnyis 'og ma mig gis bsgyur/ /'dod sbyin mda' ros rnyed steng bsre/ /gnyis 'phel shol yin lhag ma ni/ /mig gis rnyed pas 'das pa rtogs | | steng gi zla dag gnas gsum gzhag /dbus su mig sbyin so yis bsgyur | | rtsa bar gcig bsre dus kyis bgo /lhag ma thig les brgyan pa yi/ / steng nas gcig phab drug cu la/ /sbyangs lhag gza' yi chu srang yin/ /thob la gzugs bsre dbus su sbyangs/ /drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod do/ /nor la bzhi bsre steng du sbyin/ /thub pas bgos pa'i lhag ma gza'/ /zla dag gnas gnyis 'og ma la/ /zla ba mi bdag rnams bsres nas/ /dus nyis bgos lhag cha shas yin | | steng la me bsre mig gis bsgyur/ /thob pa byin la klu lag gis/ / bgos pa'i lhag ma tshogs su gyur/ /gnas gsum dbus ma drag pos bsgyur/ / rtsa bar bdun bsre so dgus dbye/ /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ /so dgus phye la rnyed pa des/ /steng nas gcig phab drug cu la/ /sbyangs lhag skar ma'i chu srang yin/ /thob pa gong mar mda' bsres pas/ /dbus su sbying zhin ( sbyin zhing ) drug cus bgo /lhag ma chu tshod steng ma ni/ /mig gis bsgyur la thob ba bsre/ /'khor los bgos lhag skar ma'o/ /gza' la gcig sbyin dbyu gur so | | chu srang nas ni bcu dbri zhing*/ /tshogs su gnyis bsre cha shas gcig / skar mar mig dang chu tshod drag /gzugs sam lag pas chu srang nas/ /'brid pa zla re'i byed pa yin/ /nyin re'i nges pa btsal ba'i phyir/ /gza' la tshes sbyin dbyu gur dbrog /tshogs su tshes sbyin bcu bzhis bgo /thob pa mnyam sbyin mi mnyam dor/ /lhag mas zla rkang gzung bya ste/ /'byung dbang mda' sde me mig gzugs | | bzlog pa dang bcas ma nu'i gnas/ /'di dang nyi ma gza' lnga la'ang | | mtshams ma 'das na zos zin dang*/

/'das na bza' rgyu'i chu tshod rnams | | bsdoms la rkang pa'i 'og tu bzhag /yang dag rgyu bas cha shas bsgyur | | dus nyis thob pa de rtsar bzhag /drug cus bsgyur la rnyed chu srang*/ / drug gis bstun nas thob pa dbugs/ /rkang pa'i dbyu gur yang dag rgyus/ / mtshams ma 'das na sbyin pa dang*/ /'das na rim bzhin sbyang bar bya/ /des ni gza' yi longs spyod du/ /sbyin dor sngar gyi mtshan mas shes/ /tshes grangs gnas gnyis steng ma ni/ /chus bsgyur 'og ma dus lag gis/ /bsgres la mkha' ros thob steng sbyin/ /drus cus thob pa rgyu skar te/ /rim bzhin nyi longs spyod du sbyin/ /de nyid gnas gnyis g.yon phyogs kyi/ /skar mar drug dang chu tshod nas/ /zhe lngas dbri ste 'khor lo phyed/ /sbyin dor rim min byang du bgrod/ / sbyin dor med rim lho bgrod do/ /skar gnas drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed nyi rkang bzung*/ /dus chu bse ru bzlog dang bcas/ /ro yi gnas su yang dag rgyus/ /lhag ma bsgres te mda' yon zlas/ /rnyed pa'i nor ni de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed chu srang ste | | drug gis bsnun nas thob pa dbugs/ /rkang pa'i dbyug gur yang dag rgyus | | snga mar sbyin zhing phyi ma la/ /rim bzhin sbyangs nas de dag gis/ / gza' dang nyi ma'i longs spyod du/ /rim min ( ¡¶ lu ¡· bzhin ) sbyin zhing rim pa sbyang | | nyi dag gnas gnyis g.yon phyogs kyi/ /skar mar tshes sbyin gnas gzhan du/ /tshes la ros bsgyur de la gza'i/ /chu tshod bsres la drug cus bgo / thob pa dang ni lhag ma dang*/ /gza' yi chu srang dbugs rnams kyis/ /g.yon gyi skar ma sogs la sbyong*/ /lhag na 'bud cing ma ldang dbab/ /nyi zla bsres la 'khor lo yis/ /phye ba'i lhag ma sbyor ba'o/ /tshes grangs mig gis bsgyur ba la | | zla bas sbyang zhing thub pas bgo /de yi lhag ma byed pa yin/

/nyi zla mig dmar gza' lhag dang*/ /phur bu pa sangs spen pa'o/ /gza' ni de nyid longs spyod tshes/ /longs spyod de yang ma 'ongs pa/ /tha skar bra nye smin drug snar/ / mgo lag nam so rgyal skag mchu/ /gre dbo me bzhi nag pa dang*/ /sa ri sa ga lha mtshams snron/ /snrubs dang chu stod chu smad dang*/ /gro bzhin mon gre mon gru dang | khrums stod khrums smad nam gru ste/ /skar ma'o sbyor ba nyer bdun ni/ / sel mdza' tshe ldan skal bzang bzang*/ /shin tu skrang dang las bzang 'dzin/ / gzer dang 'bras 'phel nyes rma chen/ /dga' ba rdo rje dngos grub ltung*/ / dpa' bo yongs bsnun zhi ba grub/ /bsgrub bya dge ba dkar po dang*/ /tshangs pa dbang po sha khon 'dzin/ /rgyu skar dang ni sbyor ba dag /longs spyod dang bcas 'das pa yin/ /gdab pa byis can ye shes til/ khyim skyes tshong dkris bkra shis dang*/ /bzhi mdo klu dang mi sdug pa'o/ /tshes gcig nyin phyed nas bzung ste | | mtshan phyed bar la gdab pa'o/ /'di yi rim pas byed bdun po/ /lan brgyad bskor rjes bkra shis sogs/ /tha ma bzhi po lan gcig 'byung*/ /gza' tshes skar ma sbyor ba dang*/ /byed pa dang ni yan lag lnga'o/ /sgra gcan zla ba rnam dag la/ /srin bug zung bsre mig gis bsgyur/ /zla bar gcig bsre nyi mar lag | mkha' dus chu bos rnyed pa dor/ /lhag ma 'khor los bsgyur ba la/ / dkyil 'khor gyis thob skar ma yin/ /lhag ma rim bzhin mkha' ro dang*/ /drug cu dang ni ros bsnun nas/ /rnyed pa chu tshod chu srang dbugs/ /des ni 'khor lo la sbyangs pa'i/ /lhag ma mun can de la ni/ /'khor lo phyed bsres dus kyi me/ / phyed dag dbyu gur bzhi bcu gnyis/ /chu srang tshes dang dbugs su bzhi/ /byin pas zla ba drug par 'gyur/ /sgra gcan legs par bstan zin to/ /gza' lnga rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /zla ba dag pa sum cus bsgyur/ /'das pa'i tshes bsre gnas gsum bzhag

/steng dbus me dang nor zla bsre/ /'og tu chu zlas sbyangs pa la/ /ri mkha' ris thob dbus su sbyin/ /chu ros thob pas steng la dbrog / gnas gnyis 'og ma ris bgos lhag /tshes de'i gza' dang mtshungs na dag / mi mtshungs steng mar snon 'brid kyis/ /mtshungs par byas pa gsal zhag yin// de la mig dmar don du ni/ /me dang mi bdag rnam bsres nas/ /ri klu dus kyis rnyed pa dor/ /gza' lhag spy-i nyi brgya yis bsgyur/ /nyi zla me dang mig gis sbyang | | ri bug ri klus rnyed pa dor/ /phur bu zla mig zung re bsre/ /de la so me rgya mtshos dbye/ /pa sangs don du phyogs kyis bsgyur/ /thub pa dus dang nyi mas spyang | | ri rgyal mig gis rnyed pa dor/ /spen pa ri bug nor mda' bsre/ / drug ro ri mkha' zlas rnyed dor/ /lhag ma 'khor los bsgyur ba la/ /dkyil 'khor gyis thob skar ma yin/ /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la/ /thob pa chu tshod lhag ma ni/ /mkha' ros bsgyur nas rnyed chu srang*/ /drug gis bsnun nas thob pa dbugs/ /so so'i longs spyod nges pa'o/ /mig dmar phur bu spen pa yi/ / longs spyod gnas gsum dbus ma la/ /bkra shis skar ma phyed bcas dgu/ / bla ma'i skar mar nyi ma dang*/ /spen pa nor zlas dbri bar bya/ /gza' lhag dkar po'i longs spyod dang*/ /ma dag nyi ma gnas gnyis kyi/ /gcig gi skar mar dkar po dus/ /lhag pa phyed bcas ¡Ã bcu drug ( ¡¶ lu ¡· drug cus ) sbyang*/ /kun gyi dal myur byed pa'i tshe/ /longs spyod nyi ma dal ba la/ /sbyong tshe 'khor lo'am de phyed kyi/ /sbyin dor rim min gzhan rim pa/ /skar gnas drug cus bsgyur la bsre | | mda' yon zlas rnyed la rkang gzung*/ /mig dmar de nyid skyon dang ri// gza' lhag phyogs ri rtse mo can/ /phur bu drag po bu ga me/ /pa sangs mda' dang rig byed zla/ /spen pa nyer gnyis tshes dang ro/ /kun kyang bzlog bcas dus kyi gnas/

/yang dag rgyu bas lhag ma bsgyur/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /rnyed pa chu srang lhag ma ni/ / ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs/ /mtshams ma 'das na sbyin pa dang*// 'das na rim bzhin sbyang bar bya/ /lhag mas longs spyod nyi ma la/ /rim min sbyin la rim pa sbyang*/ /dal ba rnam par dag pa'o/ /dmar po bla ma spen pa yi/ / dal ba gnas gnyis g.yon phyogs kyi/ /nyi ma dag pa nyid la sbyang*/ /lhag dkar dal ba gnas gnyis kyi/ /gcig gis longs spyod la sbyangs pa'i/ / lhag pa'i skar mas myur rkang gzung*/ /mig dmar rgyal ba me mig gsum/ / zla mig gnas gnyis nyes tshes drag /me'o phyi mar drag po dang*/ /so brgyad brgyad cu lnga bcu gsum/ /gza' lhag rgyal po mi bdag tshes/ /yid dang 'dod pa drag po ri/ /mda' mkha' phyi mar rig byed drag /nyi shu nyer brgyad sum cu bzhi | | phur bu phyogs bcu bu ga ro/ /dus ro mig zla phyi mar ni/ /me ro srin drag rgyal po ri/ /pa sangs de nyid gnas gsum dang*/ /rgyal ba gnas gnyis mig la gnyis/ /nyes tshes gdeng can phyi ma la/ /dus dang sum cu dgu bcu dgu

| | tha mar bdun cu rtsa gsum mo/ /spen pa dus dbang mda' chu ste/ /mig lag mkha'o phyi ma la/ /zung chu mda' dus nor me ste/ /kun kyang gnas gzhan bcu bzhi'o/ /yang dag rgyu bas chu tshod bsgyur/ /mkha' ros rnyed pa de rtsar bzhag | lhag ma chu srang 'og ma ni/ /ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs// snga mar sbyin zhing phyi mar sbyang*/ /lhag mas dal ba g.yas phyogs la/ /rim min bu lon rim pa nor/ /myur ba rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar dal myur gzhan yang ni | | drang 'khyog 'gros rnams legs shes pas/ /bkra shis zla skyes bla ma dang | | dkar po dal ba rtogs par 'gyur/ /blo gros rin chen las byung ba'i | | legs bshad 'od zer dri med phreng*/ /mi shes mun pa bsal phyir spros// mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas gyur cig /yan lag lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga dang bcas pa rnams/ tshig nyung ngus bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa/ rin po che'i 'od zer dri ma med pa zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge tshul blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sa mo bya'i lo la sbyar ba yongs su rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /nyi khyim 'pho ba'i nges pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /gsal zhing thogs med myur du 'jug khyab pa dang ni rab brten pa'i | | blo gros gang la ldan pa de/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes bya'o/ /nyi khyim 'pho ba'i nges pa ni/ /nyi dag skar ma mkha' ros bsgyur/ /chu tshod bsres la mda' yon zlas/ /rnyed pa 'das pa'i khyim gyi grangs/ /lhag ma sde pas rnyed pa ni | | 'das pa'i zhag yin lhag chu tshod/ /chu srang dus mig gis rnyed pa/ / 'das pa'i chu srang lhag ma ros/ /bsnun nas dbugs bsre nyi ma yis/ /rnyed pa 'das pa'i dbugs su 'gyur/ khyim re'i spyad bya yongs rdzogs pa/ /de yi tshe na 'pho bar 'gyur// // ༄༅/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis dus gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī kā la tsakra ga ṇi ta kā la pra kā sha dī paṃ nā ma

| bod skad du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis dus gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum dus med ngo bo nyid/ /sku gsum thugs kyi 'khor lo can/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i dpal | | dus kyi 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /don che ba la tshegs chung ba'i/ / dus kyi 'khor lo nyung ngu'i rtsis/ /dam pa'i bka' yis rab bskul nas/ / bdag gis 'dir ni bshad par bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su rab byung sogs// 'das pa bsres pa lo dag yin/ /nyi mas bsgyur la nag sogs sbyin/ /gnas gnyis 'og mar ri bsres la/ /mig gis bsgyur la mda' ro yis/ /rnyed pa steng byin zla dag yin/ /lhag ma mig gis rnyed pa yis/ /'das pa'i zla lhag nam byung brtag /sum cu gnyis gsum spel 'byung bas/ /ma 'ongs pa ni shugs las shes/ /zla ba dag pa gnas gsum bzhag /dbus su gzugs bsres so yis bsgyur/ /de la nyi ma rnam par sbyin/ /'og tu mig bsre dus kyi bgo | lhag ma phyogs kyis bsgyur ba yis/ /steng nas gcig phab drug cu la/ / sbyangs lhag gza' yi chu srang yin/ /thob pas dbus sbyang drug cus bgo /lhag ma chu tshod rnyed steng gzhug /thub pas bgos pa'i lhag ma gza'/ /gnas gnyis 'og mar nor zla sbyin/ /dus nyis bgos lhag cha shas yin/ /steng ma mig gis bsgyur ba la/ /nor la me bsres sbyin par bya/ /klu lag gis phye'i lhag ma tshogs/ /slar yang zla dag gnas gsum bzhag /dbus ma drag pos bsgyur bar bya/ /'og tu nor sbyin so dgus dbye/ /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la | | so dgus phye la thob pa yis/ /steng nas gcig phab mkha' dus la/ / sbyangs lhag skar ma'i chu srang yin/ /rnyed pa snga mar ro bsres pas/ /dbus la sbyangs nas drug cus bgo /lhag ma chu tshod steng ma ni/ mig gis bsgyur la rnyed pa gzhug /'khor los bgos lhag skar ma ste/ /dh+ru ba rnam par dag pa'o/

/ gza' la zla ba dbyu gur so/ /chu srang nas ni phyogs kyis sbyang*/ /ril por mig dang cha shas gzugs/ /skar mar mig dang chu tshod drag /gzugs mig res kyis chu srang nas/ /sbyangs pas 'og ma'i dh+ru bar 'gyur/ /gza' la mig dang chu tshod drag /chu srang la ni sbyin dor med/ /ril por nyi ma cha shas dus/ /nyi ma'i skar mar 'dod pa dang*/ /dbyu gur ro ni sbyin par bya/ /dgu dang bcu yi re mos kyis | | chu srang nas ni sbyangs pa yis/ /zla ba drug pa'i dh+ru bar 'gyur/ /nyin re'i nges pa btsal ba'i phyir/ /gza' la tshes sbyin dbyu gur dbrog /ril por tshes sbyin ma nus bgo /thob pa mnyam sbyin mi mnyam dor/ /lhag mas zla ba'i rkang pa gzung*/ /'byung dbang mda' chu me mig zla/ /bzlog pa dang bcas gnas bcu bzhi/ /'di dang nyi ma gza' lnga la'ang*/ /gal te rkang pa'i mtshams ma 'das/ /zos zin longs spyod bsdoms pa dang*/ /'das na bza' rgyu'i longs spyod rnams/ /bsdoms la rkang pa'i 'og tu bzhag /zla rkang stong par thig le dang*/ /gcig dang bcu gsum pa la lnga/ /mig dang nyi ma dag la phyogs | | me dang drag por tshes su brjod/ /chu dang phyogs la bcu dgu ste/ / mda' dang bu gar nyi shu gnyis/ /dus dang nor la rgyal ba ste/ /bdun pa la ni nyi shu lnga/ /rkang zos sngon mas cha shas bsgyur/ /dus nyis thob pa de rtsar bzhag/ lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la/ /thob pa chu srang lhag ma ni/ /drug gis bsgyur nas thob pa dbugs/ /rkang pa yi ni dbyu gu la/ /rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yis | | longs spyod mtshams ma 'das na sbyin/ /'das na rim bzhin sbyang bar bya/ /des ni gza' yi longs spyod du/ /sbyin dor sngar gyi mtshan mas shes | | slar yang tshes grangs gnas gnyis bzhag /rig byed kyis ni steng ma bsgyur | | 'og ma nyi shu drug gis bsgre/ /mkha' ros thob pa steng byin la/ /drug cus thob pa rgyu skar te/ /rim bzhin nyi ma'i gnas su sbyin/

/de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag pa yi/ /g.yon gyi skar ma'i gnas nas dus/ /dbyu gu'i gnas nas mda' chus sbyang*/ /ma ldang 'khor lo phyed sbyin zhing*/ /ci ste sbyangs kyang 'khor lo phyed/ /lhag na de nyid kyis ni sbyang*/ /de ltar sbyin dor byas pa ni/ / rim min byang du bgrod pa ste/ /sbyin dor med rim lho bgrod do/ /skar gnas drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed nyi rkang gzung*/ /ro dang chu dang zla ba ste/ /bzlog pa dang bcas dus kyi gnas/ /nyi rkang stong par thig le dang | | gcig dang mda' la dus yin te/ /mig dang chu la phyogs su brjod/ / rtse mo can la 'phrog byed do/ / ¡Ã yang dag rgyu bas lhag ma bsgyur/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - yang dag ma bsgyur// ) mda' yon zlas rnyed de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la | | 'og gi chu srang ldan byas nas/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed chu srang ste/ /drug gis bsgyur nas thob pa dbugs/ /rkang pa'i dbyug gur yang dag rgyu'i/ / longs spyod mtshams ma 'das na sbyin/ /'das na rim pa bzhin du sbyang*/ /des ni gza' yi longs spyod dang*/ /nyin mor byed pa'i longs spyod du/ /rim min sbyin zhing rim pa sbyang*/ /nyi ma dag pa gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gi skar mar tshes grangs sbyin/ /gzhan du tshes la ro yis bsgyur/ /de la gza' yi longs spyod bsre/ /mkha' ros thob pa skar ma ste/ /de yis gcig la rim bzhin sbyang | | so so'i gnas su ma ldang na/ /rang rang steng nas phab la sbyang*/ /rang grangs langs pa'am ci ste lhag /gong du phud la lhag ma gzung*/ /nyi zla bsres la 'khor lo yis/ /phye ba'i lhag ma sbyor ba'o/ /gza' ni gang shar de nyid de/ / de yis tshes kyi chad lhag brtag /longs spyod gang shar ma 'ongs pa/ /de yis tshes kyi 'pho mtshams gzung*/ /skar ma'i gnas dang sbyor ba ni/ /longs spyod dang bcas 'das pa 'char/ /tshes grangs zur bsgyur zla bas sbyang*/

/thub pas bgos lhag byed pa yin/ /nyi zla mig dmar gza' lhag dang*/ /phur bu pa sangs spen pa ste/ /nyin zhag la ni ris kyi 'jugakha cig tshes la dbang zhes zer | | tshes gcig nas brtsams dga' ba dang*/ /bzang po rgyal ba stong pa dang | | rdzogs pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ /zla ba re la lan drug 'char/ /tha skar bra nye smin drug dang*/ /snar ma mgo lag nam so rgyal/ /skag mchu gre dbo me bzhi dang*/ /nag pa sa ri sa ga dang*/ /lha mtshams snron snrubs chu stod smad/ / de nas byi bzhi 'dir mi bgrang*/ /gro bzhin men gre mon gru dang*/ khrums stod khrums smad nam gru'o/ /rgyu skar de rnams sdud byed khyim/ /lug glang 'khrig pa karka ṭa/ /seng ge bu mo srang sdig pa/ /gzhu dang chu srin bum pa nya/ /rai rer rgyu skar gnyis gnyis dang*/ /chu tshod dag ni bco lnga gnas/ /rnam sel mdza' bo tshe dang ldan/ /skal bzang bzang po shin tu skrangs/ /las bzang 'dzin pa gzer dang 'bras/ /'phel ba nges pa rma chen dang*/ /dga' ba rdo rje dngos grub ltung*/ / dpa' bo yongs 'joms zhi ba grub/ /bsgrub bya dge ba dkar po dang/ /tshangs pa dbang po sha khon 'dzin/ /sbyor ba nyi shu rtsa bdun te/ /ming gis 'bras bu yongs shes bya/ /tshes gcig nyin phyaid nas brtsams nas/ /gdab pa byis can ye shes til/ khyim skyes tshong dkris nyin zhag gi /phyed la lan brgyad bskor ba'i rjes/ /bkra shis bzhi mdo glu dang ni/ /mi sdug pa rnams lan gcig 'byung | | de ltar gza' tshes skar ma dang*/ /sbyor ba dang ni byed pa ste/ /yan lag rnam pa lnga yi rtsis/ /shin tu gsal bar bstan zin to// //de nas nyi khyim 'pho mtshams kyi/ /res kyis gza' rnams rtogs bya'i phyir | | lo dag gnas gnyis steng ma la/ /mig bsres mkha' mkha' rgya mtshos bsgyur | | 'og mar mda' dus bsres pas sbyang*/ /de la ri zla mig gis dbye/ / thob pa gza' yi gnas su bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la/

/thob pa chu tshod lhag ma ni/ /mkha' ros bsgyur la rnyed chu srang*/ /drug gis bsgres ( ¡¶ lu ¡· bsres ) nas thob pa dbugs/ /gza' la mig dang chu tshod du/ /sum cu bsres la mkha' ros dbye/ /lhag ma chu tshod rnyed steng sbyin/ /thub pas bgos pa'i lhag ma gza' | | de ni spy-i yi nges pa'o/ /so so'i nges pa brtag pa'i phyir/ /lug la gza' yi gnas su gzugs/ /chu tshod du ni ri mda' sbyin/ /glang la chu dang me mda'o | | 'khrig par gzugs dang ri zla bsre/ /karka ṭa la gza' ru mtsho/ /chu tshod du ni lnga bcu gsum/ / ¡Ã seng ger ( ¡¶ zha ¡· so sor ) gzugs dang mig lag sbyin | | bu mor mtsho dang rgyal ba bsres/ /srang la dus dang zla mda' sbyin/ / sdig par gzugs dang bzhi bcu bdun/ /gzhu la me dang mi bdag gzhug /chu srin mtsho dang ri me sbyin/ /bum par dus dang rig byed bsre/ /nya yi dbyu gur lnga bcu gnyis/ /byin pas so so'i nges par 'gyur/ /sgra gcan zla ba rnam dag la | | chu ri byin la mig gis bsgyur/ /zla bar gcig bsre nyi mar lag /mkha' dus chu bos rnyed pa dor/ /lhag ma 'khor los bsgyur ba la/ /mkha' dus chus thob skar ma ste/ /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ /rnyed pa chu tshod lhag ma ni/ / drug cus bsgyur nas rnyed chu srang*/ /lhag ma ros bsgyur rnyed pa dbugs/ /des ni 'khor lo la sbyangs pa'i/ /lhag ma mun pa can yin no/ /de la 'khor lo phyed bsres pas/ /dus kyi me yi nges par 'gyur/ /'di dag rgyu skar dkyil 'khor la | | rtag par g.yas skor rgyu ba ste/ /gza' gzhan g.yon skor gyis ni 'gro/ / de ltar gdong dang mjug ma dang*/ /stong gi nyi ma'i longs spyod dang*/ /nya yi zla ba'i longs spyod dag /mnyam na nges par 'dzin par 'gyur/ /phyed dag dbyu gur mig mtsho dang*/ /chu srang tshes dang dbugs su chu/ /byin pas zla ba drug par 'gyur | | gza' lnga nges par bya ba'i phyir/ /zla ba dag pa mkha' mes bsgyur/

/ 'das pa'i tshes bsre gnas gsum bzhag /steng dbus mig dang 'khor los sbyang | | 'og tu me dang ri dus bsre/ /ri mkha' ris thob dbugs su sbyin/ /chu ros thob pas steng la dbrog /gnas gnyis 'og ma ris bgos lhag /tshes de'i gza' dang mtshungs na dag /mi mtshungs na'ang snod 'brid kyis/ /mtshungs par byas pa gsal zhag ste/ /gza' lnga kun gyi thun mong ngo*/ /de la mig dmar don du ni/ /thub pa me dang lag pa bsre/ /ri klu dus kyis rnyed pa dor/ /lhag ma 'khor los bsgyur ba la/ /dkyil 'khor dus ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· gyis ) thob skar ma ste | | lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ /rnyed pa chu tshod lhag ma ni/ /drug cus bsgyur nas rnyed chu srang*/ /lhag ma ros bsgyur rnyed pa dbugs/ /bkra shis kyi ni longs spyod do/ /de nyid gnas gnyis ( ¡¶ zha ¡· gsum ) cig shos kyi/ /skar mar dgu dang dbyu gu nas/ /mkha' dang me yis sbyang bar bya/ /ma ldang 'khor lo phyed sbyin zhing*/ /sbyangs kyang 'khor lo phyed lhag na/ /slar yang de nyid kyis ni sbyang | | dor na rim min gzhan rim pa/ /gza' lnga kun la shes par bya/ /skar gnas drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed dal rkang gzung*/ /snga mar de nyid khams dang ri/ /phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /rkang pa stong par thig le dang*/ /gcig dang lnga la nyi shu lnga/ /mig dang mtsho la bzhi bcu gsum/ /rtse mo can la lnga bcu'o/ /yang dag rgyu bas lhag ma bsgyur/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /rnyed pa chu srang lhag ma ni/ / ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs/ /mtshams ma 'das na sbyin pa dang | | 'das na rim bzhin sbyang bar bya/ /de yi longs spyod cig shos la/ / rim min sbyin zhing rim pa sbyang*/ /mig dmar dal ba dag pa'o/ /myur la de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gis ma dag nyi mar sbyang*/ /gal te ma ldang 'khor lo sbyin/

/ci ste lhag na phyed kyis sbyang*/ /lhag ma'i skar mas myur rkang gzung | | dang por rgyal ba me mig gsum/ /zla mig gnas gnyis khams dang tshes | | drag pa me rnams snga ma'i cha/ /phyi mas 'phrog byed nor med dang*/ / mkha' nor dang ni lnga bcu gsum/ /stong par thig le gzugs rgyal ba/ /mig la ri mtsho mer bdun cu/ /chu la me bug mdar chu drag /dus la dbang 'ded rir me tshes/ /klu la nor dang rgyal po ste/ /srin por bu ga thub pa gzugs/ / phyogs la mig dang khams yin no/ /drag por zla ba ri bo gzugs/ /nyi mar med pa 'dod pa ste/ /'dod pa la ni me dang mda'/ /yang dag rgyu bas chu tshod bsgyur | | mkha' ros thob pa de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma chu srang 'og ma ni/ /ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs/ /snga mar sbyin zhing phyi mar sbyang*/ /de yis dal ba cig shos la/ /rim min bu lon rim pa nor/ /mig dmar myur ba'i nges pa'o/ /gza' lhag spy-i nyi brgya yi bsgyur/ /de la rgyal ba 'khor lo sbyin/ /ri bug ri klus rnyed pa dor/ /lhag ma rim bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ /mkha' ro mkha' ro ros bsgyur nas/ /'khor los rnyed pa rgyu skar dang*/ /chu tshod dang ni srang dang dbugs

| | lhag ma'i longs spyod nges pa'o/ /dal ba'i don du ma dag pa'i/ /nyi ma gnas gnyis cig shos la/ /skar mar mi bdag dbyu gu gnas/ /mkha' dang mes sbyang rim pa dang*/ /rim pa min pa 'dir yang dpyad/ /skar gnas drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed dal rkang gzung*/ /snga mar phyogs ri rtse mo can/ /phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /stong par thig le gzugs mda' phyogs | | mig mtshor bcu bdun mer nyi shu/ /yang dag rgyu bas lhag ma bsgyur// mda' yon zlas rnyed de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /rnyed pa chu srang lhag ma ni/ /ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs/ /mtshams ma 'das sbyin 'das na sbyang*/ /de yis ¡Ã dal ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· nyi ma ) cig shos la/ /rim min sbyin zhing rim pa sbyang*/ /gza' lhag dal ba dag pa'o/ /myur la de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gis longs spyod nges par sbyang*/ /rim dang rim min rnam par dpyad/ /lhag ma'i skar mas myur rkang gzung*/ /dang por rgyal po mi bdag tshes/ /ma nur 'dod pa drag po ri/ /mda' mkha' phyi mar rig byed drag | nyi shu nyer brgyad sum cu bzhi/ /rkang pa stong par thig le dang*/ /gzugs la rgyal po mig la so/ /rtse mo can la bzhi bcu bdun/ /chu la zla dus mda' chu ri | | dus la mda' nor rir mig srin/ /nor dang srin por ri bug go /phyogs la me bug drag mig klu/ /nyi mar mig dus 'dod mtsho me/ /yang dag rgyu bas chu tshod bsgyur/ /mkha' ros thob pa de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma chu srang 'og ma ni/ / ros bsgyur dbugs bsri rnyed pa dbugs/ /snga mar sbyin zhing phyi mar sbyang*/ /de yis dal ba cig shos la/ /rim min bu lon rim pa nor/ /gza' lhag myur ba'i nges pa'o/ /phur bu'i don du gsal zhag la/ /srin po dus dang drag po bsre | | so mar rgya mtshos rnyed pa dor/ /lhag ma rim bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ / mkha' ro mkha' ro ros bsgyur nas/

/'khor los rnyed pa rgyu skar dang*/ /chu tshod dang ni chu srang dbugs/ /phur bu'i longs spyod nges pa'o/ /de nyid gnas gnyis cig shos la/ /skar ma'i gnas nas nyi mas sbyang*/ /'dir yang rim dang rim min dpyad/ /skar gnas drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed dal rkang gzung*/ /snga mar drag po bu ga me/ /phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /stong par thig le gzugs mdar drag /mig mtshor nyi shu mer me lag /yang dag rgyu bas lhag ma bsgyur/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /rnyed pa chu srang lhag ma ni/ /ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs | | mtshams ma 'das sbyin 'das na sbyang*/ /de yis longs spyod cig shos la/ /rim min sbyin zhing rim pa sbyang*/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + phur bu'i dal ba dag pa'o/ ) /myur la de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gis ma dag nyi mar sbyang*/ /'dir yang rim dang rim min dpyad/ /sbyangs lhag skar mas myur rkang gzung*/ /snga mar phyogs bcu bu ga nor/ /dus ro mig zla phyi mar ni/ /me ro srin drag rgyal po ri | | stong par thig le gzugs la phyaugs/ /phyogs la nyi shu mer srin mig /chu la ri me mdar me chu/ /dus la srin mtsho rir zla mda'/ /nor la mig dbang srin bug chu/ /phyogs la me mtsho drag chu me/ /nyi mar me mig 'dod par ri/ / yang dag rgyu bas lhag ma bsgyur/ /mkha' ros thob pa de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma chu srang 'og ma ni/ /ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs/ /snga mar sbyin zhing phyi mar sbyang*/ /de yis dal ba cig shos la/ /rim min bu lon rim pa nor | | phur bu myur pa'i nges pa'o/ /pa sangs spyi nyi phyogs kyis bsgyur/ /de la me dus ri bo bsre/ /ri rgyal mig gis rnyed pa dor/ /lhag ma rim bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ /mkha' ro mkha' ro ros bsgyur nas/ /'khor los rnyaid pa rgyu skar dang | chu tshod dang ni chu srang dbugs/

/dkar po'i longs spyod nges pa'o/ /dal ba'i don du ma dag pa'i/ /nyi ma gnas gnyis cig shos la/ /skar ma'i gnas nas dus kyis sbyang*/ /'dir yang rim dang rim min dpyad/ /skar gnas drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed dal rkang gzung*/ /snga mar mda' dang rig byed zla/ /phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /stong par thig le gzugs mdar lnga/ /mig mtshor srin po me la phyogs/ /yang dag rgyu bas lhag ma bsgyur/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la bsre | | rnyed pa chu srang lhag ma ni/ /ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs// rkang pa'i mtshams ma 'das na sbyin/ /'das na rim bzhin sbyang bar bya/ /de yis dal ba cig shos la/ /rim min sbyin zhing rim pa sbyang*/ /pa sangs dal ba dag pa'o/ /myur la de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gis longs spyod nges par sbyar/ /'dir yang rim dang rim min dpyad/ /lhag ma'i skar mas myur rkang gzung | | snga mar de nyid gnas gsum dang*/ /rgyal ba gnas gnyis mig lag gnyis | khams tshes gdengs can phyi ma la/ /dus dang mkha' me dgu cu dgu/ / tha mar me dang ri bo'o/ /stong par thig le gzugs de nyid/ /mig la mkha' mda' me mdar ri/ /chu la srin bug mdar me nyi/ /dus la dbang po ma nu dang | | thub par ri dang rgyal po ste/ /klu la dbang po dang ni khams/ /srin por nam mkha' mkha' dang mig /phyogs la klu dang nam mkha' lag /drag por mig dang nam mkha' zung*/ /nyi mar lag pa ri bo gzugs/ /'dod par me dang thub pa'o/ /yang dag rgyu bas chu tshod bsgyur/ /mkha' ros thob pa de rtsar bzhag/ lhag ma chu srang 'og ma ni/ /ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs/ /snga mar sbyin zhing phyi mar sbyang*/ /de yis dal ba cig shos la/ /rin min bu lon rim pa nor | | pa sangs myur ba'i nges pa'o/ /spen pa'i don du gsal zhag la/ /mda' dang ri bo mkha' mig sbyin/ /dus ro ri mkha' zla rnyed dor/

/lhag ma rim bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ /mkha' ro mkha' ro ros bsgyur nas/ / ¡Ã 'khor los rnyed pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dkyil 'khor gyis thob ) rgyu skar dang*/ /chu tshod dang ni chu srang dbugs/ /spen pa'i longs spyaud nges pa'o/ /de nyid gnas gnyis ( ¡¶ zha ¡· gsum ) cig shos kyi/ / skar ma nor zlas sbyang bar bya/ /'dir yang rim dang rim min dpyad/ /skar gnas drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed dal rkang gzung*/ /snga mar mig lag tshes dang ro/ /phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /rkang pa stong par thig le dang*/ /gzugs dang mda' la nyi shu gnyis/ /mig dang chu la ri me ste/ /me la bzhi bcu rtsa gsum mo/ /yang dag rgyu bas lhag ma bsgyur/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la bsre/ /rnyed pa chu srang lhag ma ni | | ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs/ /mtshams ma 'das sbyin 'das na sbyang*/ /de yis longs spyod cig shos la/ /rim min sbyin zhing rim pa sbyang*/ / spen pa'i dal ba dag pa'o/ /myur ba de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gis ma dag nyi mar sbyang*/ /'dir yang rim dang rim min dpyad/ /sbyang lhag skar mas myur rkang gzung*/ /snga mar dus dbang mda' chu mtsho/ /mig lag nam mkha' phyi mar ni/ /mig mtsho mda' dus nor me'o/ /stong par thig le gzugs la ro/ /mig la drag po mer mi bdag /chu la mkha' mig mdar rgyal ba/ /ro la dus dang mig yin te/ /ri dang klu la gdengs can lag /srin po la ni dus dang mig /de bzhin phyogs la mig dang zung*/ /drag por ri zla nyi mar drag / 'dod pa la ni rtse mo can/ /yang dag rgyu bas lhag ma bsgyur/ /mkha' ros thob pa de rtsar bzhag /lhag ma chu srang 'og ma ni/ /ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs | | snga mar sbyin zhing phyi mar sbyang*/ /de yis dal ba cig shos la/ /rim min bu lon rim pa nor/ /spen pa myur ba'i nges pa'o/ /nyi ma dal ba'i 'gros kyis te/

/zla ba rtag par myur bar rgyu/ /sgra gcan rkang pa med pa yi/ /'gros kyis g.yas skor rgyu bar byed/ /tog ni phal cher nyi ma mtshungs/ /gza' gzhan dal myur drang ba dang*/ /'khyog pa'i 'gros bzhis rgyu ba ste/ /'di yi tshul yang gzhung gzhan dang*/ /man ngag las ni yongs shes bya/ /de ltar tshig nyung tshegs chung ba'i/ /rtsis kyi gtsug lag brjod pa las/ /bdag blo'i nongs pa gang mchis pa/ /dam pa rnams kyis bzod par dgongs/ /de las dge ba gang bskrun pa/ /de yis lus can thams cad kyis/ /sgrib med kun tu gzigs pa yi | | sangs rgyas spyan ni thob par shog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis dus gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen glo bo lo tsā ba'i bkas bskul nas/ dge slong blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'phags pa'i yul du rab byung du grags shing*/ rgya nag po'i lugs kyi me mo yos bu'i lo dpyid zla 'bring po'i yar ngo la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /rtsis dus gsal ba'i sgron ma'i don yang dag par bsdus pa bzhugs/ ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab byung sogs bsdoms bcu gnyis kyis bsgyur 'das zla bsre/ /'og tu rir bcas zung bsgyur mda' ros rnyed steng sbyin/ /gsum dbus gcig bsre sos bsgyur bcu gnyis sbyin 'og tu/ /gnyis bsgyur ris dbye lhag ma bcus bsgyur gcig steng phab/ / drug cur sbyangs lhag srang thob dbugs nas sbyangs drug cus/ /phyed lhag chu tshod thob pa steng bsre ris lhag gza'i/ /gnyis 'og bco brgyad bsres nas dus nyis phyed lhag cha/ /steng zung bsgyur la gsum bcas nor bsres nyer brgyad kyis lhag tshogs/ /gsum dbus drag bsgyur 'og tu brgyad sbyin so dgus lhag | drug cus bsgyur la so dgus thob pas steng nas gcig /drug cus sbyangs lhag srang dbugs drug cu nor/

/sbyangs nas drug cus lhag dbugs steng zung bsnun par nor/ /byin nas nyer bdun gyis lhag rgyu skar nges pa'o/ /zla dag don bzhi byin nas sum cus bsgyur tshes bsre/ /drug stong dgu brgyas phyed lhag nyer bdun la sogs kyis/ /bsgyur rnyed rnams kyis phyed dag longs spyod gzung | | zla dag sum cus bsgyur la tshes bsre gsum bkod la/ /gnyis dang nyi shu bdun sbyangs drug brgya don gsum bsre/ /bdun brgya bdun gyis thob dbugs byin nas re bzhi thob/ /stong 'phrog res gza' dang bstun gsal ba'i zhag | dmar phyir nyis brgya so bdun byin nas drug /brgya brgya bcu bdun dbye ba lhag phyir brgya yis bsgyur/ /nyis stong bdun brgya bcu drug bsres nas ni/ / brgyad stong bdun brgya go bdun gyis bgo phur phyir stong brgya re dgu bsre/ / bzhi stong sum brgya so gnyis kyis dbye dkar phyir bcu ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· bcus ) bsnun bdun brgya re gsum sbyin/ /nyis stong nyis brgya zhe bdun gyis dbye dal phyir nyis stong don lnga bris nas ni/ khri phrag bdun brgya re drug gis phye dag rnams longs spyod bya/ /longs spyod gsum dbus dmar phyir dbu dang sum cu phur bcu gnyis | | spen pa bco brgyad lhag phyir nyi mar bcu drug dang*/ /sum cu kar phyir drug sbyar rim pas yin min dpyad/ /skar lhag drug cus bsgyur bsre brgya dang so lngas dbye/ /thob pa dal rkang bzung zhing snga phyi dpyad la des/ /lhag skar nyi dang gzhan gyi longs spyod dag la ni/ /rim min sbyin zhing rim pa sbyangs pa dal ba dag pa'o/ /myur phyir dal gsum dmar phur spen pa'i gcig gi nyi mas sbyangs | | lhag skar longs spyod sbyangs shing kun gyis lhag mas myur rkang bzung*// snga phyir dpyad nas dal bar min dor rim pa nor/ /myur bar dag pa yin te gza' rnams rnam par dpyad/

dus gsal ba'i sgron ma'i don yang dag par bsdus pa rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /gdod ma'i dus gsal ba'i rtsis bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /gdod ma'i dus gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rtsis/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan dam pa dang po yi/ /sangs rgyas zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dang po'i dus tshod nges rtogs phyir/ /rtsis kyi gtsug lag 'dir bshad bya/ /chos kyi dbyings la rab byung sogs/ /'das pa bsres pa lo dag yin/ /nyi mas bsgyur la nag sogs sbyin/ /gnas gnyis 'og ma sde pas bsgyur/ /de la nor dang zla ba sbyin/ /nam mkha' me dang zla bas mgo | thob pa steng du byin pa yis/ /zla ba rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /lhag ma rgya mtshos rnyed pa yis/ /'das pa'i zla lhag nam byung shes/ /zla ba dag pa gnas gsum bzhag /dbus la gzugs sbyang so yis bsgyur/ /'og tu mes sbyangs dus kyis bgo /lhag ma thig les brgyan pa yi/ /steng nas gcig phab drug cu la/ /sbyangs lhag gza' yi chu srang ngo*/ /thob la drag po bsres la sbyang*// mkha' ros bgos lhag chu tshod do/ /thob la gzugs bsres steng du sbyin/ / thub pas bgos pa'i lhag ma gza'/ /slar yang zla dag gnas gnyis bzhag / 'og mar ri dang chu bos sbyang*/ /dus gnyis bgos lhag cha shas yin/ /steng du gzugs bsre mig gis bsgyur/ /thob pa byin la klu lag gis/ /bgos pa'i lhag ma ril po'i gnas/ /yang ni zla dag gnas gsum bzhag /dbus ma 'phrog byed kyis ni bsgyur/ /'og ma gzugs dang lag pas sbyang*/ /slar yang dgu dang me yis bgo /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la/ /so dgus phye la rnyed pa des | | steng nas gcig phab drug cu la/ /sbyangs lhag skar ma'i chu srang yin/ / rnyed pa gong mar gcig bsres pas/ /dbus nas sbyangs nas mkha' ros bgo / lhag ma dbyug gu'i gnas su bzhag /steng la gcig sbyang mig gis bsgyur/ / rnyed pa'i cha la gcig dor gzhug /'khor los bgos lhag skar ma'o/

/de nas gza' tshes skar ma dang*/ /sbyor ba dang ni byed pa ste/ /yan lag lnga yi rtsis rnams kun/ /gzhan dang mtshungs par shes par bya/ /sgra gcan zla ba rnam dag la | | 'dod pa byin la zung gis bsgyur/ /zla bar gcig bsre nyi mar mig/ mkha' dus chu bos rnyed pa dor/ /lhag ma 'khor los sgyur ba sogs/ /longs spyod kyi ni nges pa dang*/ /de las mun can dus me'i rtsis/ /ji ltar bya ba'ang gzhan dang mtshungs/ /de nas gza' lnga nges bya'i phyir/ /zla ba dag pa sum cus bsgyur | | 'das pa'i tshes bsre gnas gsum bzhag /steng ma la ni me sbyin zhing | | dbus dang 'og nas nor mes sbyang*/ /'og tu ri mkha' ris thob pa/ / dbus su byin la chu dus kyis/ /rnyed pas steng nas sbyang bar bya/ /de nyid gnas gnyis 'og ma la/ /thub pas bgos pa'i lhag ma dang*/ /tshes de'i gza' dang mtshungs na dag /mi mtshungs na yang snon 'brid kyis/ /mtshungs par byas pa gsal zhag ste/ /gza' lnga kun gyi thun mong ngo*/ /de la mig dmar don du ni/ / phyogs dang zla ba bsres byas nas/ /ri klu dus kyis rnam par dbye/ /gza' lhag spyi nyi brgya yis bsgyur/ /nor ri mkha' dang 'byung bas sbyang*/ /de la ri bug ri klus bgo /phur bu dus mda' bu gas sbyang*/ /
