¡Ã 'og ma ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· so me ) rgya mtshos rab tu dbye/ /pa sangs spy-i nyi phyogs kyis bsgyur/ /bu ga mkha' dang dus kyis sbyang*/ /ri rgyal mig gis bgo bar bya/ /spen pa chu me bu ga sbyin | | dus ro ri mkha' zla bas dbye/ /lhag mas bsgyur bya'i nges pa'o/ /de la 'khor los bsgyur byas la/ /dkyil 'khor so sos dbye ba sogs/ /longs spyod bya ba'i rim pa dang*/ /de las dal ba'i nges pa dang*/ /myur ba'i nges pa btsal ba sogs/ /gzhung gzhan las ni 'byung ba bzhin/ /'dir yang nges par sbyar ba yin/ /ji bzhin du ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /gang zhig gis ni pha mtha' yas pa'i ma 'ongs rtsis rnams rtogs 'gyur zhing*/ /de nyid ky-is ni sum stong lhag pa'i gdod ma'i rtsis kyang shes byed pa'i/ /rtsis kyi gtsug lag gsal ba 'di ni kun dga' grags kyis rab bskul nas/ /'phags pas sbyar ba'i dge ba gang des 'gro kun kun mkhyen nyid gyur cig khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po ston pa bde bar gshegs pa lhums su zhugs pa la sogs pa'i dus rnams bde blag tu rtogs par byed cing*/ bstan pa'i dus kyi rtsis la phyin ci log tu rtogs pa de dag sun 'byin par byed pa'i gtan tshigs nges par grub pa/ gdod ma'i dus gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos kyi rje dpal sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spy-i bos gus pas len pa'i dge slong blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ rab byung me mo yos bu'i lo/ dpy-id zla 'bring pau'i yar gyi ngo la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /rtsis kyi gtsug lag dang mthun par nges pa zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od rab gsal zhing*/ /brtse ba'i zla zer kun 'jug pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /gtsug lag nges pa 'dir bshad bya/ /rnam par dag pa'i mkha' dbyings la/

/shing pho byi ba la sogs pa/ /'das pa'i lo grangs bsres pa yis | | dag pa'i lo ni nges par 'gyur/ /zla ba'i don du nyi mas bsgyur/ /zla ba gcig pa la sogs pa/ /'das pa bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag /'og mar thub pa zla ba bsre/ /mig gis bsgyur la mda' ros bgo /rnyed pa steng du byin pa yis | | zla ba rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /zla dag de yang zla res bzhin/ /re re'i grangs kyis 'phel ba las/ /gang tshe cig car gnyis 'phel ba/ /de tshe de ni zla ba'i shol/ /'og gi lhag ma mig gis bgo /rnyed pa grangs ni gang yin pa | | 'das pa yi ni zla grangs te/ /de tshe zla lhag byung bar shes/ /zla ba sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ /yang ni sum cu rtsa gsum ste/ /spel zhing zla lhag 'byung ba'i phyir | | ma 'ongs pa ni shugs las brtag /de nas dh+ru ba nges bya'i phyir/ /zla ba dag pa gnas gsum bzhag /steng du rig byed rnam par sbyin/ /dbus ma sos bsgyur me bsre zhing*/ /'og tu mda' sbyin dus kyis dbye/ /lhag ma phyogs kyis bsgyur ba yis/ /steng nas gcig phab drug cu la/ /sbyangs lhag gza' yi chu srang yin | | rnyed pa'i nor gyis dbus nas sbyangs/ /de la drug cus bgos pa yi/ / lhag ma gza' yi chu tshod do/ /thog pa gang yin steng du gzhug /thub pas bgos pa'i lhag ma gza'/ /slar yang zla dag gnas gnyis bzhag /steng du rig bya sbyin bya zhing*/ /'og tu mda' dang phyogs bsres nas/ /dus dang nyi mas phye ba yi | | lhag ma cha shas nyid du 'gyur/ /steng ma mig gis bsgyur ba la/ /so dang rgya mtsho rnam par sbyin/ /rnyed pa byin la klu lag gis/ /phye ba'i lhag ma tshogs su 'gyur | | yang ni zla dag gnas gsum bzhag /dbus ma drag pos bsgyur ba la | | dus dang rgya mtsho rnam par sbyin/ /'og tu nor bsre so dgus dbye/ /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la/ /so dgus phye la rnyed pa des/ /steng nas gcig phab drug cu la/ /sbyangs lhag skar ma'i chu srang yin/

/rnyed pa nor gyis steng nas sbyangs/ /de la drug cus bgos pa yi/ /lhag ma skar ma'i chu tshod do/ /steng ma mig gis bsgyur ba la/ /mig lhag bsres nas thob pa sbyin/ /'khor los bgos lhag skar ma'o/ /de yi thob pa phal cher ni/ /phyi ma'i nges par 'gyur ba yin | | de na gza' tshes skar ma dang*/ /sbyor ba dang ni byed pa ste/ /yan lag lnga yi nyin re'i rtsis/ /gzhan bzhin 'dir yang shes par bya/ /sgra gcan nges par bya ba'i phyir/ /zla ba rnam par dag pa la/ /mda' me byin la mig gis bsgyur/ / zla ba'i don du gzugs dang ni/ /nyi ma'i don du mig bsres nas/ /mkha' dus chu bos rnyed pa dor/ /lhag ma bsgyur bya'i nges pa ste/ /de las longs spyod de las ni/ /mun pa can dang dus kyi me/ /ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa yin/ /gzhung 'dir rgyas par ma spros mod/ /gzhan dang mtshungs par shes par bya/ /'phags pa'i yul du rab byung nas/ /lo yi mgo 'dzin rgya rnams kyis/ /shing pho byi ba thog mar 'dod/ /zla ba'ang dbus 'gyur tshal du ni/ /rgyal gyi zla bas thog ma 'dren | | sham+bha la ni nag pa'i zla/ /zla ba rnams kyi thog mar 'dod/ /rgya yi sta pa dpyid ra ba/ /gcig pa zhes byar 'dod pa yin/ /bod rnams phal cher de rjes 'brang*/ /de phyir lo dang zla ba'i tshul/ /rgya yi rjes su 'brangs nas ni/ / yang dag nges pa tshol ba'i tshul/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul bzhin bshad/ /zla shol 'dor ba'i tshul yang ni/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs/ /de rjes 'brang ba'i gzhung las shes/ /bod la grags pa'i rgya rtsis pa/ /'khrul pa nyid du 'chad par byed/ /'dir ni rgya yi gtsug lag las/ /'byung ba'i tshul bzhin bdag gis bshad/ /de phyir rtsis kyi gtsug lag gnyis/ /mthun cha gzhung 'dis nges dbye bas/ /gtsug lag mthun par nges pa yin/ /'di bshad pa las gang bskrun pa'i/ /dge bas skye bo ji snyed pa/ /'khrul pa med pa'i lam zhugs nas/

/sgrib med ye shes thob par shog /gtsug lag dang mthun par nges pa zhes bya ba'i rtsis/ sa pho 'brug gi lo'i bya sbo'i zla ba'i tshes ¡Ã brgyad kyi ( ¡¶ zha ¡· gcig gi ) nyin par man gong gi sa'i char 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /dh+ru ba gnyis pa'i rtsis bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bhaṭ+ṭā ra kā ya/ gang gi thugs rjes 'gro kun rab bzung nas/ /skal pa ji bzhin smin cing grol mdzad pa/ /bla ma mchog dang dpal ldan dus 'khor la/ /gus pas btud de rtsis kyi gzhung 'di brtsam/ / nam mkha'i gnas su phyi ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· byi ) ba sogs/ /'das pa bsres pa lo dag yin | | nyi mas bsgyur la nag sogs sbyin/ /gnas gnyis 'og ma mig gis bsgyur | | chu dang rig byed rnam bsres nas/ /mda' ros rnyed pa steng du bsre/ / zla ba rnam par dag pa'o/ /gnas gsum dbus ma so yis bsgyur/ /'og ma dus kyis bgos lhag la/ /thig le byin la steng nas gcig /phab pas drug cu la sbyangs pa'i/ /lhag ma gza' yi chu srang yin/ /thob pas dbus sbyang drug cus bgo | lhag ma chu tshod rnyed steng sbyin/ /thub pas bgos pa'i lhag ma gza'/ /zla dag gnas gnyis 'og ma ni/ /dus nyis bgos lhag cha shas yin/ /mig gis steng bsgyur rnyed pa sbyin/ /klu lag gis phye'i lhag ma tshogs/ /gnas gsum dbus ma drag pos bsgyur/ /'og ma so dgus bgos lhag ma/ /drug cus bsgyur la so dgus dbye/ /rnyed pa'i nor gyis steng nas gcig /phab pa'i drug cu la sbyangs pa'i/ /lhag ma chu srang gnas su bzhag /thob ma gong mas dbus ma sbyang | | drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod do/ /zung gis steng bsgyur rnyed pa gzhug / 'khor los bgos lhag skar ma'o/ /de dag ma dag dh+ru ba yin/ /rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /gza' dang chu tshod chu srang nas/ /me dang ri mda' nyi shus sbyang | | mig mtsho cha shas dus kyi tshogs/ /skar gnas chu tshod chu srang nas/ /zla ri nyi shu drug gis sbyang*/

/rnam par dag pa'i dh+ru ba ste/ /zla ba re yi nges pa'o/ / de las tshes dang res gza' dang*/ /skar ma sbyor ba byed pa yi/ /nyin re'i nges pa tshol ba ni/ /gzhan dang 'dra bar shes par bya/ /de bzhin sgra gcan phyed dag dang | | gza' lnga po yi longs spyod kyang*/ /'di nyid kyi ni tshul lta bur/ /ma dag pa dang rnam dag pa'i/ /tshul gnyis kyi ni brtsir rung mod/ /byed pa chung phyir 'dir ma spros/ /'on kyang tshul 'dis rnam dpyad na/ /de dag kyang ni shes par 'gyur/ /de ltar byed pa'i rgyu rtsis mi 'dra bar/ /grub pa'i 'bras bu mthun pa nges byed pa'i/ /tshul 'di gzhan dag gis kyang rtogs bya'i phyir/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal gyis sbyar ba yin/ /rgyud las 'byung ba dang*/ de la brten nas gzhan dag gis sbyar ba'i rtsis kyi bstan bcos rnams dang rnam par bzhag pa mi mthun par brtsi yang*/ 'bras bu rnam par dag pa nges par 'gyur ba/ dh+ru ba gnyis pa zhes bya ba'i rtsis 'di ni/ sa mo lug gi lo la rgya'i yul du sbyar ba'o || || ༄༅/ /lo bdag nyi shu'i ∶ rtsis (《 zha 》 rtsa gnyis pa ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ mkhyen pas shes bya kun gzigs nas/ /brtse bas gzhan la ston mdzad pa/ /ston pa mchog la phyag 'tshal nas/ /lo yi bdag po'i rtsis bshad bya/ /bsil zer can la zhi ba sogs/ /'das pa bsres pa lo dag yin/ /de nyid mes bsnun chu bo sbyin/ /ris phye'i lhag ma lo bdag gza'/ /gang zhig lo yi bdag por ni/ /tsha zer byed par gyur pa na/ / de tshe 'bru dkon nags tshal dang*/ /klu dang lteng ka skam pa dang*/ /sbrul sogs srog chags gdug pas 'tshe/ /tshad sogs yams kyi nad 'byung zhing*/ /sman rnams stobs dang mi ldan la/ /dgun ni nyi mas lhag par gdung*/ /sprin rnams char dang mi ldan zhing*/ /nam mkha' zla ba rgyu skar rnams/ /mdangs dang bral bar gyur pa dang*/ /dka' thub ldan pa lhag par sdug /yul dbus dmag gis 'khrug par 'gyur/

/zla ba bdag por gyur pa'i tshe/ /sman rnams bcud dang ldan pa dang*/ /mkha' la sprin sdud char 'bebs shing*/ /chu klung lteng ka lhag par 'phel | | nags tshal me tog lo tog rgyas/ /bzhon rnams 'o ma rgyas pa dang*/ / gzhon nu rnam ni rtse zhing rol/ /mi bdag byams pas yul 'khor skyong*/ /mig dmar bdag por gyur pa'i tshe/ /me yi stobs ni cher 'phel bas/ /nags dang grong sogs sreg par byed/ /mi rnams dbul por 'gyur ba dang*/ /rkun ma lhag par 'phel 'gyur zhing*/ /yul 'gar char pa lhag par 'bab/ /la lar than pas gdung bar byed/ /'bru rnams legs par smin gyur kyang*/ /glo bur rkyen gyis nyams par byed/ /mkhris pa'i nad ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'thab rtsod rab tu mang ba dang*/ /rgyal pos yul 'khor btang snyaums 'dor/ /gza' lhag lo bdag gyur pa'i tshe/ /rig pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'jig rten rgyas par 'gyur ba dang*/ /mi rnams dul bar gnas pa dang*/ /lo thog rtsi thog rgyas pa dang | | brtul zhugs ldan pas bsnyen bkur thob/ /rgyal po rnams kyi stobs 'phel zhing*/ /'gro ba chos bzhin spyod par 'gyur/ /phur bu lo bdag gyur pa'i tshe | | mchod sbyin gnyis ni rnam par 'phel/ /dge sbyong bram zes grags pa thob | | lha rnams 'jig rten skyong bar byed/ /'bru dang rtsi shing rgyas pa dang*/ /rta dang glang po ba lang sogs/ /bzhon pa theg pa 'phel ba dang*/ /char chu dus su 'bab 'gyur zhing*/ /blo ldan rig pa rgyas par 'gyur/ /pa sangs lo bdag gyur pa na/ /rgyal rigs bzang po'i stobs 'phel bas/ /gdug pa'i sems ldan 'joms par byed/ /skye bo nad med bde bar gnas/ /tshong pa rnams kyi nor rgyas shing*/ /mgron po ji snyed bde bar 'gyur/ /sbrum ma rnams ni bde bar btsa' | | rin po che rnams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /spen pa lo bdag gyur pa'i tshe/ / dgra dang chom rkun gdon rnams kyis/ /yul 'khor 'tshe bar byed pa dang*/

/ nor phyugs dang bral nad sogs kyis/ /mi rnams 'chi ba mang ba dang*/ /dus ma yin pa'i rlung gis ni/ /sa dang nam mkha'i mdangs 'phrog cing*/ /char med chu bo 'grib par snang*/ /nyi ma zla ba mi gsal zhing*/ /la lar lo thog rnams mi skye | | la lar skyes pa nyams par 'gyur/ /bud med bu yi nad kyis 'chi/ /bu tsha btsas pa phal cher yang*/ /dbang po gtsang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lo bdag shes byas nas/ /ngan par snang la 'byung ba'i tshe/ /dge sbyong bram ze rnams kyis ni | | mchod sbyin sbyin sreg cho ga brtsams/ /bdag gis lo bdag rtsis bshad pas | | bdag gzhan bdag med don rtogs nas/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin grol ba'i/ /bdag nyid chen po bdag thob shog /lo bdag gi rtsis nyi shu ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + rtsa ) gnyis pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /rten 'brel rtsis rin chen sgron ma bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tī t+yaṃ sa mud+pā da ār+ṣa ¡Ã ta twa ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· twad ta ) rat+na dī paṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i gtsug lag gi de kho na nyid rin po che'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i rjes zhugs rgyal ba'i sras/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo pa/ /rgyal sras 'jam mgon la btud de/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung de nyid bri | | ma rig 'du byed rnam shes dang*/ /ming gzugs skye mched reg pa dang*/ / tshor ba sred pa len pa dang*/ /srid pa skye ba rga shi ste/ /'di dag rten 'brel bcu gnyis yin/ /smal po'i bcu drug nas brtsams te/ /rgyal gyi zla ba'i bco lnga'i bar | | ma rig pa yi zla bar 'dod/ /'du byed la sogs lugs 'byung gi / rim pas zla ba gzhan la sbyar/ /so so'i tshes gcig nas bzung nas/ /ma rig pa la sogs pa rnams/ /bzlog pa'i go rim ji bzhin du/ /bcu gsum pa ni gsum dang mtshungs/ /bcu bzhi bzhi mtshungs bco lnga lnga/

/dkar po'i phyogs la'ang de bzhin no/ /dang po yi ni nyin zhag la/ /nam langs nas bzung ma rig pas | | chu tshod gsum dbang rga shis chu/ /skye mda' srid 'byung len pas bzhi/ / srid me tshor mda' reg pas bdun/ /skye mched dus dang ming gzugs ro/ /rnam shes ri bo 'du byed mda'/ /tshes grangs gang la bab pa yi/ /rten 'brel de yis thog drangs nas/ /rim bzhin so so'i dus la dbang*/ /gang du tshes dang zla ba lhag /rten 'brel kyang ni de bzhin no/ /'bras bu mi bzad 'byin pa'i phyir | | de tshe zhi ba'i las mi brtsam/ /de lta'i dus tshod yongs shes nas/ /skye ba las phyogs rkun ma nad/ /mig 'gul rna ba ngu ba dang*/ /rkan 'gul ba dang ltogs pa dang*/ /rkang pa sbrid dang rkang pa'i sgra/ /gos tshig snum zhugs byi bas zos | khyi ngu bya rog sgra dang ni/ /sa g.yo mtshan ma sems pa rnams/ /mkhas pas yongs su brtag par bya/ /ma rig pa la btsas pa ni/ /nyi ma dgu dang zla ba dgu | | lo dgu dag la ma shi na/ /nor ldan snyan smra sems gdug cing*/ /nye du dang rtsod 'khrig la sred/ /rmongs shing mtha' 'khob gtso bor 'gyur/ /brgyad cu rtsa gcig 'tsho ba ste/ /'du byed la ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'du byed la btsas nyi ma brgyad/ /zla ba brgyad dang lo brgyad la/ /gal te shi bar ma gyur na/ /nad med 'byor cing tshangs par spyod/ /chos ldan mkhas shing bden par smra/ /grogs mang kun la phan par 'gyur/ /brgyad cu brgyad 'tsho rang nyid kyi/ /yul du rnam shes nyi mar 'chi/ /rnam shes la ni btsas pa gang*/ /nyi ma lnga dang zla ba lnga/ /lo lnga dag la ma shi na/ /mkhas shing spro ring phongs pa dang*/ /rtul phod kyis ni pha rol gnon/ /sdig la dga' zhing chags par ldan/ /nga rgyal che zhing tshig rtsub smra

| | mgon med nyam thag mkhas pa la/ /rtag tu byams par byed pa dang*/ / nad med gzhan la brten pas 'tsho/ /drug cu bzhir 'tsho ming gzugs kyi/ /nyi ma la ni mtshon gyis 'chi/ /ming dang gzugs la btsas pa ni/ /nyi ma drug dang zla ba drug /lo dgu'am de bzhin bcu gnyis la/ /gal te de ni ma shi na/ /nad dkon phongs shing bu mi 'tsho/ /blo zhan sgra yi 'jigs dang bcas/ /gtum zhing nga rgyal ldan pa dang*/ /dman ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dam ) pa la brtse ngan dang 'grogs/ /chung ma gsum ni yod par 'gyur/ /de yi pha ma tshe ring zhing*/ /tshong gi las kyi 'tsho ba dang | | tshe yi mtha' mar longs spyod ldan/ /bdun cu gcig tu 'tsho ba ste/ /skye mched drug gi nyi mar 'chi// ༈ //skye mched drug la btsas pa gang*/ /nyi ma lnga dang zla ba lnga/ /lo bcu'am de bzhin lo brgyad la/ /glo bur du ni ma shi na | | skye ma thag tu ma ni 'chi/ /pha yang lo brgyad dag la 'chi/ /dpa' zhing rang gi khyim na gtso/ /nad ldan ser sna che zhing phongs/ /drug cu bzhir 'tsho reg pa la | | rang gi khyim du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /reg pa la btsas nyi ma gnyis/ /gsum lnga zla ba lnga dang dgu/ /lo dgu dag la ma shi na/ /blo ldan mkhas shing rig pa shes | | nga rgyal che zhing tshig rtsub smra/ khro zhing brtson 'grus ldan pa dang*/ / 'khrig pa la sred phrag dog ldan/ /rku zhing rab tu sgrin pa ste/ /drug cu gsum 'tsho tshor ba la/ /chu 'am rgyal po'i chad pas 'chi/ /tshor ba la ni gang zhig btsas | | de ni nyi ma gnyis sam bcu/ /zla ba brgyad dam lo brgyad la/ /glo bur du ni ma shi na/ /bzo yi gnas la mkhas shing 'byor/ /sdig pa'i sems ldan gzhan gyis bkur/ kha gsag g.yo yis pha rol slu/ /nad bu can du 'gyur ba dang | | rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs pa ste/ /chung ma gnyis ldan 'khrigs la sred | | sum cu'am lnga bcu'am drug cu la/ /'chi gyur sred pa'i nyi ma la'o// ༈ //sred pa la ni gang btsas pa/ /nyi ma bcu dang zla ba gsum/

/lnga 'am yang na lo dgu na/ /srog ni 'gags par ma gyur na/ /gzugs bzang 'byor zhing grags pas mdzes/ /tshul khrims rnam dag chos dang ldan/ /yang na de ni gtso bor 'gyur/ /bzo dang sgyu rtsal kun la mkhas/ /sems lhod bud med gcig dang ldan/ /bu dang tsha bo mang 'gyur zhing*/ /nad dkon kun la snyan tshig smra | | dgra mang grogs kyang mang ba ste/ /brgyad cu bzhi 'am drug cur 'tsho/ / len pa'i nyi mar de 'chi'o/ /len pa la btsas nyi ma dgu/ /zla ba gnyis sam de bzhin brgyad/ /lo dgu dag la ma shi na/ /gzugs ngan drag shul che ba dang*/ / cung zad tsam gyis dga' mgu byed/ /sems drang rgyun du sems khral can/ / tshul khrims 'chal zhing 'dod la sred/ /de ni gzhan gyi yul na gtso/ /mang du smra zhing pha rol slu/ /drug cu rtsa bzhir 'tsho ba ste/ /'dze'am yang na chu yis ni/ / rang gi yul du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /srid pa yi ni nyi ma la'o/ /srid pa'i nyi mar btsas gyur pa/ /nyi ma dgu dang zla ba dgu/ /lo dgu dag la ¡Ã gshin rje yi ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ma shi na ) / /gdon las gal te thar gyur na/ /brtson ldan sgeg cing dpa' ba dang*/ /'byor zhing don mang tshong gis 'tsho/ /gzhan gyi chung ma la sred cing*/ / sems gdug rnyed chung dmag dpon 'gyur/ /bzo gnas la mkhas gzi brjid can | | chung ma gnyis ldan drug cur 'tsho/ /skye ba'i nyi mar 'chi 'gyur te/ / mtshon nam srog chags gdug pas so/ /skye ba'i nyi mar gang btsas pa/ /nyi ma dgu dang zla ba dgu/ /lo dgu la ni glo bur du/ /gal te shi bar ma gyur na/ / dbul zhing chos ni spyod pa dang*/ /yul 'khor las ni mi bskyod cing*/ /gzhan gyis mchod pa'i gnas su gyur/ /bden par smra zhing snyan par brjod/ /bzo dang sgyu rtsal las la mkhas/ /chung ma gcig ldan gnyen la byams/ /bdun cur 'tsho zhing rga shi la/ /chu yi gnod pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rga shi la ni btsas gyur pa | | nyi ma gnyis dang zla ba bdun/

/lo dgu dag la ma shi na/ /yid gzhungs gnyen 'dun rnams la byams/ /gdug cing sdig pa'i las la dga'/ /byis pa'i tshe na nad dang ldan/ /phyi nas nad byang dgra nyung zhing*/ /drug cu rtsa bzhir 'tsho ba ste/ /lus kyi yan lag smas nas kyang*/ /ma rig pa yi nyi ma la/ /'chi bdag dang ni phrad par 'gyur/ /skye ba brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa yi nyi ma la/ /gtong dang mchod sbyin zhing khang brtsams/ / mgo lus bkrus na bkra shis shing*/ /gos gon phan thogs mi 'gyur ro/ /'du byed rig bslab mda' gzhu bzung*/ /rang gi las bya bag ma blang*/ /dgra gzhom khang pa brtsig par bya/ /lus bkrus yid 'ong gos rnyed 'gyur/ /mgo bkrus gos gsar bgos gyur na/ /nad dang skrag sngangs 'byung bar 'gyur/ / sbyin pa gtang bar mi bya'o/ /rnam shes rgyal por dbang bskur zhing*/ /dmag bsdu dgra 'dul grong las bya/ /mgo bo bkrus na yid 'ong zhing*/ /lus kun bkrus na skrag sngangs 'byung*/ /gos gsar bgos na mdzes par 'gyur/ /ming gzugs 'jigs las grol ba dang*/ /zhi ba'i las bya shis pa brjod/ /bla ma bsten par bya ba dang*/ /skra dang kha spu sen mo breg /lam du zhugs na bde bar rgyu | | mgo bo bkrus na skra dkar 'byung*/ /lus bkrus skrag sngangs 'byung ba ste | | gos bgos myur du 'dzad par 'gyur/ /skye mched drug la dbang bskur dang | | gtso bor gnas dang yul gzung dang*/ /gtar sba grong 'jug brtan las 'grub/ /lus kun bkrus na pha ma skrag /mgo bkrus gos gon mdzes par 'gyur/ /reg pa la ni rku ba dang*/ /mthu dang srog gcod la sogs pa/ / drag cing rtsub pa'i las rnams 'grub/ /mgo bo bkrus na rtsod pa 'byung*/ /lus po bkru bar mi bya'o/ /gos bgos mdza' bo'i khrag mthong zhing*/ /yun ring gnas par mi 'gyur bas/ /bgo bar mi bya gyon 'dod na/ /dge slong la ni btud de bgo /tshor bar mdza' bo yid 'ong dang*/ /bran dang nor bsdu bag

ma blang*/ /tshong bya chu bo dag las bsgral/ /mgo bkrus skra 'byi skrag sngangs 'byung | | lus kun bkrus na yid mi bde/ /grogs po'i mdun du gos bgos na | | yid la 'dod pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /sred par nor rdzas bsdu bar bya/ / sa bon btab na 'bru rnams 'phel/ /mgo bo bkrus na skra 'byi zhing*/ /lus po bkrus na skrag sngangs 'byung*/ /de yi mtshan mo gos gon na/ /rtag tu bde ba nyid du 'gyur/ /len pa'i nyi mar nor bsdu zhing*/ /zhi ba'i las bya bag ma blang*/ / slob dpon du ni gnas pa dang*/ /sman sbyar pho nya btang ba dang*/ /skra dang kha spu sen mo breg /mgo bkrus 'byor zhing skra bzang 'gyur/ /lus bkrus nor rnyed dpal dang ldan/ /gos gon phan thogs mi 'gyur ro/ /srid par lha yi rnal 'byor dang*/ /sngags 'grub mdza' bo bsdu bar bya/ /gzhan yang dge ba'i las rnams 'grub/ /rtsod spang mgo bkrus bza' ba rnyed/ /lus bkrus mdzes zhing mtshan mo'-i tshe/ /rgan la btud nas gos gyon shis/ /skye ba khyim dang gtso bo'i las | | 'grub 'gyur mgo bkrus bkur sti thob/ /lus bkru yid dga' gos gyon na/ /yun ring gnas shing phan thogs 'gyur/ /rga shir nor bsdu mchod sbyin bya/ /rtsod spang mgo bkrus bde bar 'gyur/ /lus bkrus nad dang god rlag 'byung*/ /gos bgos yun ring mi gnas so/ /las brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa la shar du shis/ /lho dang nub tu rtsod dang 'phrad/ /don du gnyer ba 'grub mi 'gyur/ /byang du snyan pa'i tshig thos so/ /'du byed shar du nor rnyed ldog /lhor song mya ngan zhi zhing bde/ /nub tu zas 'thob btsal ba rnyed | | byang du don grub bde bar ldog /rnam shes shar du nyon mongs shing*/ / lhor song nye zho med par ldog /nub tu rtsod phrad byang phyogs su/ /nor rnyed ming gzugs nyi ma la/ /lho dang shar du bsam pa rdzogs/ /nub dang byang du don mi 'grub | |

skye mched shar du nor rnyed 'gyur/ /lhor song don grub bde bar ldog | nub dang byang du re ba rdzogs/ /reg par shar du nad kyis thebs/ /lhor mdzes nub tu ca co 'byung*/ /byang du nor rnyed 'gor bar 'gyur/ /tshor bar shar du sems bde zhing*/ /mya ngan dang ni bral bar 'gyur/ /lho ru nad 'byung rtsod dang 'phrad/ /nub tu shi ba'i gtam thos shing*/ /byang du snyan pa'i tshig thos 'gyur | | sred par shar du bgo ba rnyed/ /lho ru song na nor rnyed cing*/ /mya ngan phran tshegs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nub tu shi ba'i gtam thos la/ /byang du song na bde bar ldog /len par shar du skrag par 'gyur/ /lhor mdzes nub tu 'jigs par 'byung*/ /byang du bsam rdzogs bde bar ldog /srid pa'i nyi ma shar du song*/ /'jigs shing kun nas nyon mongs 'gyur/ /lho dang nub dang byang phyogs su/ /'dod pa'i don grub bde bar ldog /skye bar shar du nor rnyed mod | | de ni brlag par 'gyur ba yin/ /lhor song mdzes shing gtam snyan thos | | nub tu nye zho med par ldog /byang du nor rnyed rga shi la/ /shar du song na myur du ldog /lho ru snyan pa'i tshig thos so/ /nub tu skrag sngangs 'byung bar 'gyur | | byang du song na bde bar 'gyur/ /phyogs brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa yi nyi ma la/ /gal te nor ni stor gyur na/ /rkun ma byang phyogs nas 'ongs pa/ /skra ngan zhig gis khyer gyur nas/ /grong khyer shar phyogs mi ring bar/ /gnas te nyi ma dgu na rnyed/ /'du byed la ni rkun ma de/ /shar phyogs nas 'ongs ser skya'i mdog /rtag tu chom po la dga' zhing*/ /gos ngan gon pas shar phyogs su/ khyer te sher na des gtod 'gyur/ /rnam shes la ni rkun ma de/ /rang gi khyim gnas ser skya'i mdog /gdong gi dbyibs chung des khyer te/ khas mi len yang rnyed par 'gyur/ /ming gzugs rkun ma spun gnyis pa | | gcig ni skra gnag gzhan skra dkar/

/bzhin mi sdug cing bzo shes pa/ / des khyer nyi shu gcig na rnyed/ /skye mched drug la khyim mtshes mi/ kha dog ser skya mig che zhing*/ /gsus pa che ba des khyer te/ /chu 'gram grong la brten pa yi | | nad pa zhig la bcol nas gnas/ /zhag gnyis dag la ma khugs na/ / phyis ni rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /reg la rang gi khyim mtshes te/ /rtag tu 'ong zhing mang du smra/ /skra nag tsho zhing spobs pa che/ /mi bzhi dang ni 'grogs nas brkus | | glengs na bsnyon zhing yun rings na/ /rtsod pas gzhan la skrag nas gtod | | tshor ba'i nyi ma rkun ma ni/ /gcig pu thag ring nas 'ongs pa/ khra bo'i khy-i ni rjes 'brang ba/ /des brkus nyi shu gcig na gtod/ /sred pa yi ni nyi ma la | | nub phyogs nas 'ongs phongs pa ste/ /des brkus khyi nag yod pa yi/ /mi zhig la ni gtams gyur te/ /de dang rkun ma de 'thabs nas/ /mi des bdag la gtod par 'gyur/ /len pa shar nas 'ongs pa'i mi/ /gnyis kyis brkus nas nub tu song*/ /nor gyi don du brtsad gyur nas/ /gcig gis bdag la nor gtod do/ /srid pa'i nyi mar rkun ma de/ /shar gyi phyogs nas 'ongs pa ste/ / g.yer bag dang ldan shin tu sgrin/ /des brkus yun ring lon pa na/ /mi zhig 'khus nas rnyed par 'gyur/ /skye ba la ni rkun ma gsum/ /phyi mi gnyis dang nang mi gcig /de la dal bus sher na ni/ /yun ring zhig na gtod par 'gyur/ / rga shi la ni nor stor na/ /byang phyogs nas 'ongs lus ring zhing*/ /skad mdzer so chag skra dkar can/ /ma mchu 'phyang ba zhig gis brkus/ /nyi ma nyi shu lnga la rnyed | | rkun ma brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa yi nyi ma la/ /gal te nad kyis thebs gyur na/ /shin tu bag bya zla phyed la/ /ma shi na ni gsum na 'tsho/ /'du byed bdun la ma shi na/ /de nas nyi ma gsum na 'tsho/ /rnam shes nyi ma gsum dang lnga/ /de bzhin brgyad la ma shi na/ /de rjes zhag bdun dag la 'tsho/

/ming gzugs lnga'am gsum las thar | | bdun la nges 'tsho skye mched la/ /gsum mam bzhi la ma shi na/ /bcu la nad las thar bar 'gyur/ /reg par gsum la ma 'gags na/ /brgyad la 'tsho zhing skyes bu de/ /tshe ring nad med bde bar 'gyur/ /tshor bar nyi ma dgu pa la | | 'chi bdag dang ni ma phrad na/ /de nas bcu na nges par 'tsho/ /sredapar brgyad la ma shi na/ /bcu pa la ni 'tsho 'gyur te/ /gal te de las 'das na 'chi | | len par nyi ma brgyad pa la/ /lus sems bral bar ma gyur na/ /bcu la 'tsho zhing srid pa la/ /gsum mam dgu la de yi srog /ma 'gags na ni lnga la 'tsho/ /skye bar lnga la ma shi na/ /bcu pa la 'tsho rga shi'i tshe/ /nyi ma gsum mam bdun pa la/ /gshin rje'i gdon gyis ma zin na/ /nad las thar zhing bde bar 'gyur/ /nad brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa yi nyi ma la/ /mig 'gul pha ma skrag par 'gyur/ /'du byed g.yon pas mdzes 'gyur zhing*/ /g.yas pas bya ba cung zad 'grub/ /rnam shes g.yon pas bgo ba rnyed/ /g.yas pas rtsod 'byung ming gzugs la/ /nor rnyed skye mched drug la ni/ /g.yon pas mdzes shing g.yas pa yis/ /nor nyams reg pa'i nyi ma la/ /g.yon pas rtsod 'byung g.yas nor rnyed/ /tshor bar g.yon pas bza' btung rnyed/ /g.yas pas mya ngan 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sred par g.yon pas gnyen 'du zhing*/ /g.yas pas stor ba rnyed par 'gyur/ /len pa la ni bgo ba rnyed/ /srid par rtsod dang nor rlag 'byung*/ /skye ba la ni mgron 'ong zhing | | rga shir g.yon pas bgo ba rnyed/ /g.yas pas pho nya'am mdza' bo'am// glo bur ba ni 'du bar bstan/ /mig 'gul ba brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa yi nyi ma la/ /rna ba g.yas pa ngu na ni/ /sdug pa'i bud med 'du bar bstan/ /g.yon pas bza' dang btung ba rnyed/ /'du byed g.yas dge g.yon nor rnyed/ /rnam shes la ni dga' zhing mdzes/ /ming gzugs g.yas pas nor rnyed cing*/ /g.yon pas dgra yi 'jigs pa 'byung*/

/skye mched g.yas skrag g.yon pas rtsod/ /reg par g.yas pas 'jigs shing sdang*/ /g.yon pas mgron 'ong tshor ba la/ /g.yas dge g.yon pas nor rnyed 'gyur/ /sred par g.yas pas mdza' sdug gi /gtam snyan thos shing g.yon pas ni/ /shi ba'i gtam thos len par g.yas/ /gzhan la phan thogs g.yon pas mdzes/ /srid par g.yas pas gtam snyan thos/ /g.yon pas mdzes 'gyur skye bar g.yas/ / dga' bar byed pa'i gtam snyan thos/ /g.yon pas stor ba'i khungs 'byung ngo*/ / rga shi'i nyi mar g.yas pas ni/ /nad dang bral bar 'gyur ba ste/ /g.yon pas gos rlag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rna ba ngu ba'i brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa la rkan 'gul na/ /mgron 'ong 'du byed nyi ma la/ khyim gyi gtso bo dag la shis/ /rnam shes ma rig pa dang mtshungs/ /ming dang gzugs la gos rnyed 'gyur/ /skye mched yid la zug rngu 'byung*/ /rig pa bde ba'i thabs dang 'phrad/ /tshor bar 'jigs shing sred pa la/ khyim der nyul ba'i skye bo 'ong | | len par 'ga' zhig 'chi bar 'gyur/ /srid pa la ni mgron 'ong zhing*// skye bar rkun ma'i 'jigs dang bcas/ /rga shir gnas de rgyal bar 'gyur/ /

rkan 'gul ba brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa la ltogs gyur na/ /rtsod 'byung 'du byed nor rnyed 'gyur/ / rnam shes la ni glo bur 'jigs/ /ming gzugs pha dang ma la bzang*/ /skye mched glo bur las rtsom 'gyur/ /reg pa la ni pha ma skrag /tshor ba'i nyi mar lam du 'jug /sred par 'jigs pa chen po 'byung*/ /len par mgron 'ong srid par shis/ /skye ba'i nyi ma 'jigs 'gyur zhing*/ /rga shi la ni rgan rabs dran | | ltogs pa brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa yi nyi ma la/ /rkang pa sbṛd na bkra shis so/ /'du byed gtso bo rnams la bzang*/ /rnam shes la ni 'dri ba 'ong*/ /ming dang gzugs la rtsod pa 'byung | | skye mched gtso bo kun la shis/ /su zhig shi ba'i gtam thos 'gyur/ / reg dang tshor ba sred pa la/ /rtsod pa 'byung bar rab tu bstan/ /len par 'ga' zhig shi ba thos/ /srid par nor rnyed skye ba la/ /nad dang rkun ma'i gnod pas 'jigs/ /rga shir mya ngan cung zhig 'byung*/ /rkang pa sbṛd pa brtag pa'o || || ma rig pa la rkang pa'i sgras/ /mgron 'ong yang na gter dang 'phrad/ / 'du byed stor ba'ang rnyed par 'gyur/ /rnam shes mu stegs sogs pa yis/ / rgol ba 'byung zhing ming gzugs la/ /mdza' bo 'du 'gyur skye mched la/ / mgron 'ong rje bo bde legs 'gyur/ /reg par dge ba'i gtam thos shing*/ / tshor bar stor ba'am yang na rnyed/ /sred par nor rnyed len pa la/ /sdig pa'i las dang phrad pa dang*/ /su zhig der ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /srid pa la ni 'du 'dzi'am | | yang na rkun po 'byung bar bstan/ /skye bar gnyen 'du rga shis rtsod// rkang pa'i sgra brtag pa ste/ nang brtag pa'o// //ma rig gos tshig don nyams 'gyur/ /'du byed ming gzugs bde legs so/ /rnam shes rnyed pa cung zad 'thob/ /skye mched ca co 'byung ba dang*/ / nor rnyed 'gyur zhing reg pa la/ /gnas der su zhig 'chi bar bstan/ /tshor bas bya ba cung zad byed/

/sred pa la ni nor rnyed pa'am/ /yang na nad kyi thebs par 'gyur/ /len pa la yang nad 'byung zhing*/ /sred pa'i nyi mar rab tu bkres | | skye bar khyim de shin tu 'byor/ /rga shir 'khrug pa'am ca co 'byung*/ / gos tshig pa brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa la gos la snum/ /zhugs na shi ba'i gtam thos 'gyur/ /'du byed gos rnyed rnam shes la/ /pha ma skrag 'gyur ming gzugs kyis/ /mya ngan rnying pa cung zhig ldang*/ /skye mched drug la 'jigs skrag 'byung*/ /reg par gnyen 'dun bde legs 'gyur/ /tshor ba la ni yid mi bde/ /srid par dpal ldan len par ni/ /cir yang 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /srid par bde legs skye ba la/ / legs pa dang ni 'phrad par 'gyur/ /rga shis rtsod cing nor rnyed do/ /gos la snum zhugs pa brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa la byi bas gos/ /zos na rtsod pa'am sdug bsngal 'byung*/ / 'du byed khyim de 'byor par 'gyur/ /rnam shes la ni stor ba rnyed//ming dang gzugs la stor ba'am/ /yang na rnyed pa nyid du 'gyur/ /skye mched drug la me'am chur/ /'ga' zhig 'chi bar 'gyur bar ston/ /reg par nor rnyed tshor ba la | | rje dpon gyis ni gos ster 'gyur/ /sred par su zhig shi ba thos/ /len pa la ni mu ge'am/ khyim der 'jigs pa 'byung bar bstan/ /srid pa'i nyi mar rkun po 'ong*/ /skye ba la ni phyug por 'gyur/ /rga shis nor la god rlag 'byung*/ / gos byi bas zos pa brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa yi nyi ma la/ khyi ngus glo bur mgron po 'ong*/ /'du byed la ni rgyal po'i las/ /byed 'gyur rnam shes nyi ma la/ /rkun po 'byung ba'am nor rnyed do | | ming gzugs shi ba'i gtam thos 'gyur/ /skye mched drug la ca co 'byung*// reg pa'i nyi mar rkun po 'ong*/ /tshor ba sred pa len pa la/ /rtsod pa 'byung zhing srid par ni/ khyim gyi lha ni khros par bstan/ /skye bar gnas der bde legs 'gyur

| | rga shi'i nyi ma mgron 'ong zhing*/ /bya ba cung zad 'grub 'gyur ro/ khyi ngu ba brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa yi nyi ma la/ /bya rog sgra yis rigs mthon po'i/ kha smras 'ong zhing 'du byed la/ /snyan pa thos pa'am rang gi khrag /mthong 'gyur rnam shes ca co 'byung*/ /ming gzugs la ni grogs dang 'phrad/ /skye mched drug dang tshor ba la | | mgron 'ong reg pa'i nyi ma la/ /glo bur skrag sngangs 'byung bar 'gyur/ / sred par bu tsha btsas pa yi/ /snyan pa'i gtam thos len par ni/ /gnyen 'dun 'chi ba nyid du 'gyur/ /srid par nor rnyed skye ba la/ /lung ma bstan du shes par bya | | rga shi la ni ca co 'byung*/ /bya rog gi sgra brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa la sa g.yos na/ /rgyal po'i lung 'byung 'du byed la/ /mu ge 'am 'thab rtsod 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rnam shes rtsod 'byung nor yang rnyed/ /ming gzugs chom rkun zhi bar 'gyur/ /skye mched rgan rabs rnams la ngan/ /reg par rtsod 'byung tshor ba la/ /gzhan gyi pho nya 'byung bar 'gyur/ /srid pa yi ni nyi ma la/ /shar du sa g.yos sgra 'byung zhing*/ /lhor g.yos mgron po 'ong bar bstan | | nub tu g.yos pas yams nad 'byung*/ /byang du g.yos pas nor rnyed pa'am/ /pho nya 'ong bar bstan pa yin/ /len par dmag gi 'jigs pa 'byung | | srid par lo tog phun sum tshogs/ /skye bar dmag gi 'jigs pa 'byung | | rga shis mi mthun phyogs la gnod/ /sa g.yos pa brtag pa ste/ phyi rol brtag pa'o// //gtso bo nyid la reg pa ni/ /bde ba dag gi 'byung gnas yin/ /ma rig pa la gang reg pa/ /don rnams 'grub par nges par bstan/ /nor dang 'bru dang bu dang phyugs/ /gnyen dang mdza' bshes yid 'ong rnams/ /dus ni ring por mi thogs par/ /'dir 'phrad 'gyur la the tshom med/ /'du byed la ni reg tsam gyis | | lam du 'jug par 'gyur ba dang*/ kha zas sems dang bu dang ni/ /lam phyar sems las 'du bar bstan/

/rnam shes bya ba mi g.yo ba/ /bsnyen bkur grogs ni 'du ba dang*/ /yid mi bde ba zhi ba dang*/ /bya ba 'grub par nges par bstan | | ming gzugs yid ni mi bde zhing*/ /'jigs pa kun tu 'byung ba dang | | rtag tu bya ba nyams pa dang*/ /rang gi gnyen dang 'bral bar 'gyur/ / skye mched drug gis grogs rnams dang*/ /phan tshun skyes kyis 'drul 'gyur zhing*// yid 'ong tshig ni sgrogs par byed/ /bu ni skye 'gyur nges par ston/ /reg pas kun nas nyon mongs shing*/ /ca co rkun ma'i 'jigs pa 'byung*/ /bkra mi shis dang de bzhin nad/ /rang gi gnyen dang mi mthun 'gyur/ /tshor bas bza' dang btung la sogs/ /gos dang rgyan dang 'phrad 'gyur zhing*/ /nor stor ba ni rnyed pa dang*/ /sdug pa'i bud med 'du bar bstan/ /sred pa la ni sems khral che/ / bsam pa thams cad 'bras bu med/ /de yi yid la gang 'dod pa/ /de dag 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /len pa la ni skal bzang zhing*/ /zhi srung pa dag rab tu ston/ /mal stan dang ni khyim la sogs/ /nor rnams nges par rnyed par 'gyur | | srid par reg pas nyon mongs shing*/ /rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs pa 'byung | | gnas las nyams dang mya ngan dang*/ /rigs ni nyams 'gyur nges par bstan/ /skye bar reg pas longs spyod dang*/ /nor rnams thams cad rnyed par 'gyur/ /grogs rnams kyis ni mchod pa dang*/ /kun gyis rab tu bsngags par 'gyur/ /rga shi thams cad don med de/ /kun tu chags bral snying po can/ / sog sbur bzhin du 'bras med par/ /bsam pa'i las rnams ston par byed/ / yan lag bcu gnyis 'khor lo la/ /ma rig la sogs mtshan ma bri/ /'dri pos gang dang gang du reg /de dang de ni nges bstan bya/ /mtshan ma brtag pa'o// //ma rig pa la rang don du/ /'du byed la ni khyim gyi'o/ /rnam shes gnyen gyi don du ste/ /ming gzugs kyis ni rtsa lag gi /skye mched drug gis mdza' bshes kyi/

/reg pas dgra bo tshor ba yis/ /bud med dang ni 'du ba'i don/ / sred pas mi chos len pas chos/ /srid pas bya ba chen po'i don/ /skye bas nor gyi don du'o/ /rga shi rdzas kyi ched ka'o/ /'di dag sems pa brtag pa yin/ /blo gros rgya mtsho rab zab par/ /brtson pa'i klu dbang gis bsgrubs pa'i/ /bstan bcos rin chen sgron ma 'dis/ /blo yi mun pa sel bar byed/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni/ /yan lag bcu gnyis gtsug lag gi /de nyid ji bzhin mdor bsdus pa/ /'di ni bdag gis legs par bsdebs/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba ni/ /dri med rab tu dkar ba des/ /'gro ba ma lus 'phags pa yi/ / spyan lnga dang ni ldan par shog/ //rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gtsug lag gi de kho na nyid/ nyung ngus bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa rin po che'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge tshul blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /rgyal bu jim gyim gyis chos 'khor bskor ba'i rtsis bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas bltams pa la sogs pa'i dus ni/ 'dul ba gzhung dam pa las/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das zla ba gang la bltams pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dpyid zla tha chungs la'o/ /mgon med zas sbyin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zla ba gang la bla na med pa'i ye shes khong du chud pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dpy-id zla tha chungs la'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs las/ 'dren pa khyod ni rgyal la bltams/ / mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis kyang gdab/ /ces 'byung bas dpyid zla tha chungs sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dro la bltams so/ /yang 'dul ba lung las/ tshes bco lnga'i mtshan mo zla ba sgra gcan gyis zin pa'i tshe/ ser skya'i gnas su sras sgra gcan 'dzin bltams la/ de'i tshe rdo rje'i gdan du thub pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/

/zhes 'byung bas sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /'phags pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ dpyid zla tha chungs nya'i nang par sangs rgyas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus dang nye bar gyur pa zhes bya ba dang*/ 'dul ba lung las/ dge slong dag do nub nam gyi gung thun la/ bcom ldan 'das dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /dpyid zla tha chungs kyi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i mtshan mo mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas de lo sum stong bzhi brgya bcu tham pa song nas/ me mo glang gi lo la rgyal bu jim gyim gyis chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ro// // ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas kyi dus chen bzhi'i ngos 'dzin bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dga' ldan nas 'phos nas/ yum gyi lhums su zhugs te | me mo yos bu'i lo/ dpyid zla tha chungs sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal dang 'dzom pa la/ lum+pa'i tshal du sku bltams/ de nas rim gyis gzhon nu'i rol rtsed dang sgyu rtsal mthar phyin/ btsun mo'i 'khor nas byung ste/ rgyal srid spangs nas/ lo nyi shu rtsa dgu lon pa'i tshe/ shing mo lug gi dpyid zla tha chungs kyi tshes brgyad la gyad kyi yul mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du rab tu byung*/ de nas lo drug tu dka' ba spyad nas byang chub kyi snying por gshegs/ bdud btul | lcags pho byi ba'i lo/ dpyid zla tha chungs kyi nya la rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas | de nas zhag bdun phrag bdun du chos ma gsung pa la brgya byin dang tshangs pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab nas/ wā rā ṇa sīr 'khor lnga sde bzang po la bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de nas bya rgod phung po'i ri dang yul mnyan yod la sogs par theg pa chen po la sogs pa theg pa gsum ci rigs pa'i chos gsungs/

byi ba'i lo dgun zla tha chungs sta pa'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la cho 'phrul chen po bstan nas mu stegs btul/ de nyid kyi ston zla tha chungs smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la grong khyer gsal ldan du lha'i gnas nas byon/ cho 'phrul chung ngu bstan pa zhes grags/ de ltar lo bzhi bcu rtsa drug tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ /dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gcig la me mo phag gi lo/ dpyid zla tha chungs kyi tshes bco lnga la grong khyer rtswa mchog tu shing sā la zung gi drung tshal du mya ngan las 'das so/ /'di rnams mdo las 'byung zhing nges par brtags pas yid ches so/ /de ltar sangs rgyas la cho 'phrul che chung gnyis/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang sku bltams pa gnyis la dus mchod bzhir grags so/ /shākya'i dge slong 'phags pas yi ger bkod pa'o || || ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ he ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā// // chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 330PAGE 331
